jobs.title: PhD Position – AI-Driven Multimodal Analysis and Predictive Modelling of Biomaterials
jobs.description:
About the position 

Biomaterial Science (BIOMAT) / Institute of Clinical Dentistry, Faculty of Dentistry, is offering a PhD position focused on AI-driven quantitative analysis and predictive modelling of biomaterials, tissues, and regenerative constructs.

The project combines advanced 2D and 3D bioimaging, including micro/nanoCT, confocal microscopy and SEM, with computational image analysis, computer vision and machine learning. The aim is to develop robust and standardized methods to link structural, mechanical and biological properties to biomaterial performance and tissue reconstruction.

The PhD candidate will work with multimodal datasets from biological tissues and engineered biomaterials and contribute to research on:

  • quantitative 2D and 3D analysis of biological tissues using nanoCT;
  • characterization of fibrous biomaterial scaffolds, including porosity, fiber architecture and structural stability;
  • standardization and computational analysis of biomedical imaging data;
  • AI-based prediction of cell and exosome distribution in regenerative biomaterials.

The candidate will receive interdisciplinary training in biomaterials research, advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, data processing and machine-learning-based modelling.


More about the position

The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The appointment is for 3 years and the place of work is Oslo, Norway.

The research will primarily be carried out at the Oral Research Laboratory, which provides infrastructure for biomaterial production and characterization, cell culture, SEM, confocal microscopy, micro/nanoCT and histology.

The project has a strong focus on regenerative medicine and dental applications, including hard- and soft-tissue reconstruction.

The three-year project is expected to produce three scientific papers and a doctoral thesis.


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Perform quantitative 2D/3D analysis of biological tissues and biomaterials using micro/nanoCT, confocal microscopy and SEM
  • Characterize fibrous scaffold architecture, porosity and structural stability
  • Develop computer vision and machine learning methods for multimodal bioimaging data
  • Build AI models predicting cell and exosome distribution in regenerative biomaterials

More about the fellowship

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The appointment is for three years and is devoted to the doctoral project and required research training.

Admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Dentistry is a prerequisite for taking up the position. The candidate is expected to complete the project within the fellowship period. A final plan for the research training must be approved and formalised no later than three months after the start of the position.

The main supervisor will be Associate Professor Athina Samara. 


Qualification requirements

Mandatory requirements

  • MSc and BSc in Biomaterials, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, Medical Technology, or a closely related field.
  • Relevant experience with biomedical imaging, quantitative data analysis, image processing, machine learning, biomaterials, or related methods.
  • Documented interest in interdisciplinary research combining biological and computational approaches.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desirable qualifications

  • Documented Experience with Python and/or another scientific programming language.
  • Documented Experience with image processing, computer vision or machine learning or 
  • Documented Experience with 2D or 3D biomedical imaging, quantitative or multimodal biological datasets.
  • Familiarity with biomaterials, tissue engineering, scaffolds, hydrogels or 3D biological models.

What are we looking for in you?
  • You work independently, precisely and systematically, while asking for input when appropriate.
  • You have strong practical and analytical skills 
  • You are scientifically curious, critical and willing to revise methods when the data do not support initial assumptions.
  • You communicate clearly and contribute constructively to interdisciplinary teamwork.
  • You demonstrate research integrity, realistic planning and the persistence required to complete a three-year PhD project.
  • Employment in the position will be based on a comprehensive assessment of the qualification requirements, the relevance and quality of previous academic and practical experience, motivation for the project, scientific potential and personal suitability.

We need different perspectives in our work

  • UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that aims to provide an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. We fulfil our mission most effectively when we draw on different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
  • We will do our best to accommodate individual needs. Relevant adjustments may include adaptations to working hours, tasks, digital or physical tools, or other practical measures. Applicants with an immigrant background, a disability or gaps in their CV are encouraged to indicate this in the application portal. UiO invites at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups to interview in accordance with applicable state-sector procedures.

Why should you choose us?
  • A clearly defined and fully funded three-year PhD project with established core infrastructure.
  • Dedicated supervision and research training in dental biomaterials, development of wear-testing methods, crown-material processing, mechanical characterisation, surface characterisation, micro-CT and quantitative image analysis.
  • An interdisciplinary and internationally connected research environment at the Faculty of Dentistry.
  • Access to modern laboratories and opportunities for collaboration with clinical and engineering research groups.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities, good welfare schemes and up to 1.5 hours of exercise during working hours.(Good welfare schemes)
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (Statens Pensjonskasse), with beneficial pension, mortgage and insurance arrangements.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment, with extensive cultural and outdoor opportunities.
  • Dedicated mentoring and a professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 551000 - to 605000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


How to apply

Your application must include:

  • A cover letter of no more than two pages describing your motivation for the position, your relevant academic and practical experience, and how your background matches the project.
  • A CV summarising education, work experience, research experience and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of diplomas, academic transcripts and certificates. Applicants should retrieve available results from Vitnemålsportalen; where this is not possible, copies must be uploaded.
  • Documentation of English proficiency where required under the Faculty’s supplementary admission rules.
  • A complete list of publications and other academic work, if applicable, together with the work the applicant wishes the evaluation committee to consider.
  • Contact information for two to three references, including name, position, relationship to the applicant, e-mail address and telephone number.
  • The application and all attachments must be submitted through UiO’s electronic recruitment system, Jobbnorge, by clicking “Apply for the position”. All documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Applicants with education from outside Scandinavia should include an explanation of their university’s grading system and a Diploma Supplement where available. A recognition statement from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), if already obtained, may also be attached.
  • Particular emphasis will be placed on documented academic qualifications, relevant experimental competence, motivation and personal suitability. The best-qualified candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to give a brief presentation of previous research or technical work.

General information

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian),  Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology, and services). 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 28 000 students and 7000 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Faculty of Dentistry is one of the leading odontological research and educational institutions in Europe. The faculty's research groups contribute top research within several odontological fields.

In addition to educating dentists and dental hygienists, the Faculty has Ph.D program and professional-oriented specialist education. The Faculty holds significant competence in the various research and clinical disciplines, with good interdisciplinary collaboration. It is a modern faculty with approximately 420 students and approximately 420 employees. The faculty is also Norway's largest dental clinic with approximately 50,000 patient visits a year. The Faculty of Dentistry has two departments: Institute of Clinical Dentistry and Department of Oral Biology.

jobs.title: Kan du tenke deg å hjelpe til med min 7 år gamle datter med funksjonsnedsettelse?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en enslig pappa som har min datter på 7 år annenhver uke. Da har jeg også ansvar for hennes lillebror på 4 år.

Vi bor på Madla og jeg trenger hjelp til min datter i partallsuker. Det hadde vært så hyggelig å høre fra deg som har følgende egenskaper:

-         Kan kommunisere på engelsk, da jeg snakker best engelsk fremfor norsk. (Men det er ikke    ett krav da vi får det nok godt til på norsk også).

-         Er punktlig. Det er et krav da det må være BPA til stede når hun kommer hjem med drosje fra skolen for å ta henne imot.

-         Har godt humør, kanskje kan du synge litt for min datter, det liker hun.

-         Er kreativ og aktiv i væremåte, det vil hjelpe henne og deg gjennom dagen.

-         Erfaring som medmenneske


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil bli litt som dette, men vi blir også enige underveis hva som fungerer for deg og for min datter:

-         Arbeidstid ca. 4,5 timer om dagen, og aldri lenger jobbing enn til kl. 20:00 om kvelden.

-         Bading/personlig stell.

-         Ut på tur hver gang været tillater det. Gjerne 30 minutter eller mer.

-         Mating via sonde.

-         Gi medisiner.

-         Ordne med vask/stell av klærne til min datter.

-         Re opp sengen hennes.

Full opplæring vil bli gitt til alle arbeidsoppgaver. Det viktigste for meg som hennes far, er at du er pålitelig. Og at vi kan ha en god kommunikasjon dersom du må endre en vakt eller blir syk slik at jeg vet hva jeg har å forholde meg til. Dette går selvsagt begge veier.

I første omgang trenger jeg hjelp fra deg en fast dag i partallsuken, og kanskje annenhver helg, dersom du har mulighet til det, her blir vi enige.  Så er det fint om du har mulighet til å stille ekstra opp ved sykdom hos annen BPA, og ved ferieavvikling.

Kaffe og te kan du alltid få, og du kan ta med egen niste dersom du må spise i løpet av vakten din hos oss.


Vi håper å høre fra deg så fort som mulig og vi vil velge å innkalle til intervju fortløpende etter hvert som vi får inn CVèr.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor, Machining D&M  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

Would you like to develop both people and processes in a modern manufacturing environment?

We are now looking for an engaged and driven Production Supervisor to join Machining D&M in Huskvarna. In this position, you will combine close and supportive leadership with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery and continuous improvement. You will be an important member of the D&M management team, with the opportunity to influence both daily operations and the and the strategy of the business.

About the role

As Production Supervisor, you will be responsible for the day-to-day leadership and operations within Machining D&M. Through visible, supportive and coaching leadership, you will develop the organization while keeping people, safety and performance at the center.

You will have direct responsibility for a team of process operators and technicians. You will also work closely with colleagues within quality, engineering, maintenance and logistics to ensure that the organization achieves its targets.

An important part of the role is to lead continuous improvement activities in line with HOS, the Husqvarna Operating System, and to ensure that the department meets our high standards for quality, delivery performance and operational efficiency.

Your main responsibilities will include

    Leading the daily operations and performance of Machining D&M
    Managing, coaching and developing a team of process operators and technicians
    Ensuring achievement of targets within safety, quality, delivery and cost
    Driving continuous improvement and operational excellence in line with HOS
    Developing people, capabilities and a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement

About you

You are a confident, clear and engaging leader with a genuine interest in both people and technology. You create involvement, build strong teams and drive development through a coaching and supportive leadership style.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where change and continuous improvement are natural parts of everyday work. You are comfortable setting expectations and following up on results, while remaining present and accessible to your team.

To succeed in the role, we also believe that you are collaborative, structured and able to turn operational challenges into practical actions and improvements.

Your skills and background

    Experience of leading employees within a manufacturing environment, for example as a team leader
    Experience of driving continuous improvement and change initiatives
    A good understanding of manufacturing processes and operational development
    The ability to analyze results and translate them into concrete actions
    Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be considered an advantage:

    HOS, Lean or a comparable production system
    CNC machining or other machining operations
    Work environment management and rehabilitation processes
    Post-secondary education within engineering, production, manufacturing or leadership

Location

This position is based in Huskvarna, Sweden.

How we work

As a Production Supervisor, you will be a hands-on leader in our production environment, working closely with your team and the wider organization every day. Your physical presence on site is essential to ensure smooth operations, enable fast decision-making, foster collaboration and provide visible, supportive leadership.

We believe that being close to the operation and the people who make it happen creates the best conditions for learning, continuous improvement and great results. This role is based full time on site.

Your application

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person.

For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Niclas Thulin niclas.thulin@husqvarnagroup.com

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people. As a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work and bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och hitta, attrahera och bygga relationer med några av Sveriges vassaste ingenjörer? Har du erfarenhet av techrekrytering, kandidatdialoger och search, och vill ta nästa steg i en roll där du får kombinera operativ rekrytering med strategiskt kandidat- och konsultarbete?

Då kan du vara vår nästa Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist på Xamera.

Om Xamera

Xamera hjälper teknik- och industribolag att hitta, matcha och utveckla rätt ingenjörskompetens. Vi är specialister på ingenjörers arbetsmarknad och arbetar med företag som behöver bygga framtida kompetens, förstärka team eller tillföra specialistkunskap i viktiga skeden.

Vår utgångspunkt är enkel: rätt ingenjör på rätt plats skapar värde både för företaget och för individen. Därför arbetar vi nära kunder, kandidater och konsulter för att förstå behov, potential, drivkrafter och sammanhang.

Xamera har en lång historia av att arbeta nära universitet, studenter och nyexaminerade ingenjörer. Den erfarenheten är fortfarande en viktig del av vår identitet. Samtidigt har vårt erbjudande vuxit. I dag hjälper vi kunder genom flera olika lösningar, från nyexaminerade ingenjörer och personer tidigt i karriären till erfarna specialister och sammansatta team.

Med vår position Find the right engineer tar vi nästa steg som helhetsleverantör inom ingenjörskompetens.

Om rollen

Som Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist får du en nyckelroll i att bygga och utveckla Xameras kandidat- och konsultbas inom erfarna ingenjörer, tekniska specialister och techprofiler. Rollen är central för vår fortsatta utveckling inom framför allt Expert och Extend, där vi hjälper kunder att snabbt få tillgång till erfaren ingenjörskompetens, specialistkunskap och leveranskraft.

Du kommer att arbeta nära våra Business Managers, Account Managers och rekryteringsteam för att förstå marknadens behov, identifiera rätt profiler och bygga långsiktiga relationer med kandidater och konsulter. Rollen handlar både om att hitta rätt person till rätt uppdrag och om att bygga en stark plattform för framtida konsultaffär.

Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan rekrytering, relationer, affär och kultur. Du gillar att förstå människor på djupet, drivs av att skapa träffsäkra matchningar och vill bidra till att Xamera blir en självklar partner för ingenjörer som vill utvecklas i sin karriär.

Du kommer att arbeta med

    

Identifiera, attrahera och rekrytera erfarna ingenjörer, tekniska specialister och techkonsulter.

    

Driva search, kandidatdialoger, förstaintervjuer och kvalificering av seniora kandidater.

    

Bedöma teknisk kompetens, drivkrafter, konsultmässighet, självständighet och kulturell passform.

    

Bygga och vårda långsiktiga relationer med relevanta kandidater och konsulter.

    

Arbeta nära Business Managers och Account Managers för att förstå kundernas behov och marknadens efterfrågan.

    

Bidra till att utveckla rekryteringsstrategier för våra konsultupplägg inom Expert och Extend.

    

Säkerställa en professionell, tydlig och förtroendeskapande kandidatupplevelse.

Vi söker dig som

Har erfarenhet av rekrytering, talent acquisition eller search inom tech, IT, produktutveckling, ingenjörsroller eller konsultverksamhet. Du är trygg i kandidatdialogen och van vid att bygga relationer med personer som ofta är selektiva, efterfrågade och inte nödvändigtvis aktivt söker nytt.

Du har förmågan att förstå både kandidatens drivkrafter och kundens behov. Du vet att en bra matchning handlar om mer än teknisk kompetens. Det handlar också om personlighet, självständighet, utvecklingsvilja, sammanhang och förmågan att skapa värde i rätt miljö.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är lyhörd, affärsnära och strukturerad. Du trivs med att ta ansvar, driva processer framåt och arbeta nära både kandidater och interna stakeholders.

Vi ser gärna att du:

    

Har erfarenhet av rekrytering inom tech, IT, produktutveckling, ingenjörsroller eller konsultaffär.

    

Är van vid search och proaktiv kandidatbearbetning.

    

Har erfarenhet av att rekrytera erfarna profiler, specialister eller konsulter.

    

Är stark i kommunikation och relationsbyggande.

    

Kan arbeta både operativt och strategiskt i en snabbrörlig miljö.

    

Är strukturerad och van att hantera flera processer parallellt.

    

Är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Personlighet väger tungt hos oss. Vi tror att du är nyfiken, prestigelös och förtroendeingivande. Du gillar att skapa kontakt, ställa rätt frågor och förstå vad som faktiskt får människor att vilja ta nästa steg.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos Xamera blir du en del av ett entreprenöriellt bolag i utveckling. Vi har en tydlig riktning framåt, ett starkt erbjudande och en ambition att bli den självklara kompetenspartnern för teknik- och industribolag som behöver ingenjörskompetens.

Som Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist får du en roll med stort ansvar och tydlig påverkan. Du blir en viktig del i att bygga Xameras framtida konsultaffär och stärka vår relation till erfarna ingenjörer och tekniska specialister.

Vi erbjuder:

    

En central roll i utvecklingen av Xameras arbete med seniora kandidater och konsulter.

    

Möjlighet att påverka hur vi bygger kandidatpipeline, search och konsultrelationer framåt.

    

Ett brett erbjudande där du får arbeta med både Expert, Extend och andra delar av Xameras helhet.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: AI for Real-Time Microstructure Monitoring Using Laser Ultra
jobs.description:
Project Description

Background
Laser Ultrasonics (LUS) is a powerful non-contact technique for in-situ characterization of metallic materials at elevated temperatures. In hot strip mill environments, LUS enables real-time monitoring of grain size evolution through analysis of ultrasonic wave attenuation and velocity, providing critical insight into recrystallization, grain growth, and phase transformations. This information is highly valuable for advanced process control strategies aimed at improving product quality, consistency, and resource efficiency.

The NAICE project (Non-destructive AI enhanced online grain size evaluation) addresses a key challenge in fossil free steel production: today’s steel mills lack real time information about the microstructure that governs material quality, leading to unnecessary energy use, scrap, and slow process adjustments. By upgrading the world’s only industrial laser ultrasonic grain size gauge and collecting a unique large dataset, the project will train models to enable AI enhanced measurement of the grain size and microstructure in real-time. This enables smarter process control, higher yield, and reduced emissions.

This thesis is the first of two planned master thesis works. The first will evaluate the best options using historical data sets, whereas the second will focus on using the full dataset and optimizing the model for industrial implementation.

If you want to know more about the LUS technology and the installation of the world’s only grain size gauge there is a recorded webinar here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOpXUAPhEv0&t=665s  

Thesis Scope
The thesis will focus on the application of machine learning and AI techniques to Laser Ultrasonic (LUS) data acquired in a hot strip mill environment. The available dataset consists of:

    Raw LUS A-scan signals with multiple backwall echoes (20 µs duration, 1 ns resolution)
    Grain size values calculated using an established conventional algorithm (serving as reference values)
    The primary objective is to develop and evaluate AI-based approaches for:
- Grain size prediction directly from raw laser ultrasonic signals
- Microstructure state classification (e.g., recrystallized fraction, pancaking/aspect ratio)

A key part of the work will be to survey suitable AI architectures, such as time-series models, deep learning approaches, and alternative signal-processing-informed models, and assess their applicability to the LUS data.

Tasks

    Survey and critically assess relevant AI/ML architectures for ultrasonic time-series data
    Pre-process and structure high-resolution LUS A-scan datasets for model training
    Develop and implement selected AI models
    Perform benchmark comparisons between different approaches with respect to:  
    Prediction accuracy
    Robustness to signal variability
    Computational efficiency and suitability for real-time deployment
    Analyze model interpretability in relation to known physical phenomena

Expected Outcomes

The thesis should deliver:

    A structured comparison of candidate AI approaches for LUS-based grain size prediction
    Prototype models demonstrating feasibility on the historical dataset
    Recommendations for model selection in future industrial implementation

Desired Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated student with:

    A background in computer engineering, engineering physics, materials science, applied mathematics, or similar
    Strong interest in machine learning and signal processing
    Experience with Python/Matlab and ML frameworks

    Basic understanding of wave physics, ultrasonics, or materials science (meriting but not required)
    Analytical mindset and ability to work with complex datasets

Additional Information

    The work will be carried out in close collaboration with experts in Laser Ultrasonics and industrial process monitoring, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge development of AI-driven process control in steel manufacturing.

Project time
The project is intended for a master thesis (30hp), starting in spring 2027 or can be mutually decided through negotiations.

Further information
This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp).

Contacts
For further information please contact:  

    Mikael Malmström, mikael.malmstrom@swerim.se
    Hampus Wikmark Kreuger, hampus.wikmark@swerim.se

Application
Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in Swedish (or English). You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means there is no explicit deadline.

jobs.title: Uddannet pædagog søges
jobs.description:
Uddannet pædagog søges – 35 timer i hyggelig børnehave i Vanløse

Har du lyst til at blive en del af en lille børnehave, hvor nærvær, relationer, leg og høj pædagogisk faglighed går hånd i hånd?
Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog på 35 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026.

Velkommen til Slettegården

Vi er en lille, selvejende børnehave med 23 børn, og vi har eksisteret i mere end 80 år. Vi er en del af Nord klynge 7 og har FOBU som paraplyorganisation.

Slettegården ligger i en hyggelig ejendom i Vanløse, hvor to lejligheder er slået sammen til vores børnehave. Vi har vores egen dejlige legeplads, og fordi vi er et lille hus, er der kort fra idé til handling.

Her kender vi hinanden godt. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer med hinanden og har mulighed for at være tæt på både børn, forældre og kolleger.

Hos os er pædagogikken i centrum

Vi brænder for vores pædagogiske arbejde og lægger stor vægt på kvaliteten i hverdagen.

Vores arbejde tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte barns behov, udvikling og perspektiv. Vi arbejder med Den Styrkede Pædagogiske Læreplan og har fokus på vores kerneopgave: at skabe trygge, udviklende og inkluderende rammer, hvor alle børn kan trives og udvikle sig.

Vi tager børnenes perspektiver alvorligt og følger gerne barnets spor. Samtidig prioriterer vi børnenes frie leg højt og ser legen som en vigtig del af børnenes udvikling, fællesskaber og læring.

Vi arbejder også med SprogTrappen. Erfaring med SprogTrappen er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Slettegården er desuden uddannelsesinstitution. Vi har både PAU-studerende og pædagogstuderende i deres første praktik. Derfor ser vi gerne, at du har lyst til at dele din faglighed og være med til at skabe et trygt og inspirerende læringsmiljø for kommende kolleger.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • er uddannet pædagog og brænder for arbejdet med børnehavebørn

  • møder børn og voksne med omsorg, anerkendelse og respekt

  • har blik for det enkelte barns behov og kan følge barnets spor

  • har et positivt syn på livet, mennesker og børns udviklingsmuligheder

  • er optaget af den pædagogiske kerneopgave og kvaliteten i hverdagen

  • kan bevare overblikket, også når hverdagen bliver travl

  • trives med faglig sparring og tæt teamsamarbejde

  • har lyst til at bidrage med idéer og være med til at udvikle vores pædagogiske praksis

  • kan arbejde systematisk med dokumentation, evaluering og den pædagogiske læreplan

  • har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores uddannelsesmiljø

Hos os får du

  • 23 skønne børn og en hverdag, hvor relationerne er i centrum

  • en lille og nærværende arbejdsplads, hvor du får mulighed for at præge hverdagen

  • gode fysiske rammer både ude og inde

  • vores egen dejlige legeplads med plads til leg og fordybelse

  • et tæt og velfungerende samarbejde med forældre og bestyrelse

  • et godt samarbejde med andre institutioner i området

  • et aktivt fagligt miljø med høj faglig integritet og stolthed

  • en alsidig hverdag, hvor vi tager børnenes frie leg alvorligt

  • gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og for at sætte dit præg på vores pædagogiske praksis

Det siger forældrerådet om Slettegården

"Vi oplever Slettegården som af høj faglig kvalitet, hvor de ansatte får mulighed for at skabe en hverdag, der giver mening for både børn og voksne. Forskellige kompetencer inden for pædagogfaget er en styrke, og vi oplever både, at de mere krea-glade og bevægelsesglade pædagoger får lov til at blomstre med dét, de kan."

"Som forældre oplever vi en god tone, hvor personalet kan have det sjovt sammen, men også har en tydelig faglighed, der skinner igennem i hverdagen. Slettegården er et lille sted, hvilket betyder et tæt samarbejde mellem os forældre og pædagogerne."

"Legepladsen er nyrenoveret og har mange forskellige legezoner, hvilket børnene nyder godt af."

Forældrerådet kan kun anbefale Slettegården til en pædagog, der tager stolthed i sin faglighed, ligesom de andre pædagoger i huset gør. Slettegården er en rigtig lille perle for en pædagog.

Vi tror på, at det gode arbejdsmiljø skabes sammen

Vi er en lille personalegruppe, og derfor betyder det meget for os, at vi hjælper hinanden, er nysgerrige på hinandens perspektiver og kan grine sammen – også når hverdagen er travl.

Vi søger en kollega, der har lyst til at engagere sig i fællesskabet, som kan tage ansvar selvstændigt, og som samtidig har lyst til at bruge sine kolleger til sparring.

Hvis du kan se dig selv som en del af Slettegården, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Praktisk information

Stilling: Uddannet pædagog, 35 timer ugentligt
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026
Løn: Efter gældende overenskomst
Antal stillinger: 1
Ansøgningsfrist: 18 oktober.  2026 – vi holder samtaler løbende

Send din ansøgning og CV til lv54@kk.dk.

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os i løbet af uge 43, er stillingen gået til en anden ansøger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – måske bliver du vores nye kollega!

jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i København?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i København.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

 Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

 Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 

Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

 

 Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

 Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

 Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

 Stillingen er på fuld tid, og du skal være indstillet på weekendarbejde – pt. hver 3. weekend. Det er desuden et krav, at du har kørekort. Når du ikke er ude på fremvisninger, arbejder du primært fra vores kommende kontor i København.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til København og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere effektivt på både dansk og engelsk.

 Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

 Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Designer  BMS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Join one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and help power what comes next

At Husqvarna Group, innovation has been part of the story since 1689. Today, we are reinventing how people care for forests, parks, gardens and construction environments — with robotics, battery systems, smart technologies and sustainable product platforms at the center of that journey. Our Battery Competence Center is where electrification becomes real product technology, and we are now strengthening the hardware team with a Senior Hardware Designer who knows BMS development in depth.



About the role

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will take battery subsystem requirements and turn them into robust BMS hardware solutions together with system engineers, cell specialists, software engineers and manufacturing experts

Your responsibilities

    Derive hardware requirements from battery subsystem requirements and translate them into practical design choices.
    Define BMS hardware architecture and functional blocks based on system architecture, requirements, standards and certification needs.
    Create schematics and PCB designs in OrCAD, including symbols, footprints and production-ready documentation.
    Define the BMS interfaces to the battery system and contribute to the optimal EE layout of the battery design.
    Select electronic and electrical components with the right balance of performance, safety, availability and manufacturability.
    Prepare manufacturing deliverables for PCBA production and support test, troubleshooting, verification and validation.
    Define AFE parameters, operating modes and BMS functions in close collaboration with cell experts, system engineers and software engineers.
    Specify the hardware–software interface together with the software team and ensure clear, structured technical documentation.



The technical landscape

You will work close to the product and close to the details. The role suits someone who enjoys circuit-level problem solving, knows the trade-offs in BMS hardware, and can move naturally between architecture, schematic design, PCBA realization, verification and cross-functional decision-making.



Location

Huskvarna or Jonsered in Sweden or Karlstein am Main in Germany.



How we work

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This helps us maintain a strong culture, supports learning and development, and ensures everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.



What we believe you bring

    BSc or MSc in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
    Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in electronics/hardware development.
    Documented experience in hardware design for Battery Management Systems — this is essential.
    Strong experience in circuit and PCBA design and the confidence to work independently in complex designs.
    Hands-on experience with AFEs, MCUs and BMS-related hardware architectures.
    At least 3 years of OrCAD experience for schematic and PCB design.
    Fluent English, both spoken and written.



Why join Husqvarna Group?

If you are a senior BMS hardware engineer who wants ownership, technical depth and the chance to influence products at scale, we would be happy to hear from you. You will join a global innovation leader with a strong engineering culture, exciting electrification challenges, international collaboration and real opportunities to influence products used by millions of customers worldwide.

Application

Does this sound interesting? Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.



Please note that due to the holiday period, response might take longer than normal.



For more information about the position, please contact – Alireza Ahadpour Shal, Senior Hardware Engineer, at Alireza.Ahadpour.Shal@husqvarnagroup.com



For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner – Katarina Engberg at katarina.engberg@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we will ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. Further background checks may be conducted where relevant.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

If you aren’t chosen to proceed in the process, you will be informed of this at the latest when the position has been filled.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.



Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

jobs.title: Resort Manager / North Resort Oy
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme North Resort Oy:lle Pelloon Resort Manageria vastaamaan uuden resortin päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja liiketoiminnan kokonaisuudesta. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan North Resort Oy:n palvelukseen.

North Resort Oy rakentaa Pellon Miekojärven rannalle uuden ympärivuotisen matkailuresortin, jossa yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen majoitus, laadukas ravintolatoiminta, henkilökohtainen palvelu ja aidot lappilaiset elämykset. Resortin toiminta käynnistyy marraskuussa 2026, ja ensimmäiset kansainväliset asiakkaat vastaanotetaan joulukuun alussa.

Tutustu yritykseen tarkemmin: https://www.northpremiumresort.com/

Resort Managerina

Työskentelet käytännönläheisessä johtotehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät henkilöstön, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin, talouden, turvallisuuden ja operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat:

* henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdytys ja kehittäminen,
* asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun johtaminen,
* myynnin, käyttöasteen ja kaupallisen toiminnan kehittäminen,
* budjetointi, talouden seuranta ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen,
* varausjärjestelmien ja myyntikanavien kehittäminen sekä
* turvallisuuden, omavalvonnan ja vastuullisuuden varmistaminen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Sales Managerin sekä muiden avainhenkilöiden ja sidosryhmien, kuten matkailukumppaneiden ja viranomaisten kanssa. Toimit esihenkilönä resortin eri toimintojen päälliköille ja raportoit yhtiön johdolle ja hallitukselle.

Tehtävä edellyttää

* kokemusta matkailu-, hotelli-, ravintola- tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta,
* vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta,
* kaupallista ja taloudellista ymmärrystä,
* hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja,
* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä,
* kiinnostusta uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamiseen,
* sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Parhaiten tehtävässä menestyy henkilö, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, esimerkiksi Resort Managerina tai Hotel Managerina. Meille koulutusta tärkeämpää on näyttö onnistuneesta kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta. North Resortin tiimiin sopii parhaiten oma-aloitteinen, käytännönläheinen ja vastuunkantokykyinen johtaja, joka viihtyy kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja innostuu uuden rakentamisesta.

Vastineeksi osaamisestasi tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan uutta, korkeatasoista matkailukohdetta sen ensimmäisistä vaiheista lähtien ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi resortin toimintamalleihin, prosesseihin ja työyhteisöön. Työskentelet kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamisessa. Tehtävän palkka on neuvoteltavissa huomioiden aiempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi. Tarvittaessa autamme myös asunnon järjestämisessä.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi pian nettisivuillamme olevan hakulomakkeen kautta tai kysy lisätietoja. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Head of Safety
jobs.description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Head of Safety at Esrange Space Center.

At Esrange Space Center, safety is fundamental to everything we do. Our operations include sounding rocket and balloon launches, rocket testing, and the development of orbital launch capabilities – activities that place high demands on safety, coordination and regulatory compliance.

As Head of Safety, you will lead and coordinate the overall safety work at Esrange Space Center. Your mission is to ensure a safe environment for employees, customers, contractors, visitors and the public across operations that include rocket and balloon launches, testing and future orbital launch activities.

You will set the frameworks and requirements for our safety work and lead experts within areas such as range safety, flight and campaign safety, occupational health and safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness. This is a strategic role with a strong operational focus, significant decision-making authority, and close collaboration with internal teams, authorities, and local stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS

    A relevant degree in engineering, safety, risk management, HSE or fire protection, or equivalent experience.
    At least five years of safety or HSE experience from a regulated industrial or operational environment.
    Experience leading specialists and coordinating safety across several functions.
    Experience developing and maintaining safety management systems.
    Strong knowledge of risk management, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
    Experience working with authorities, permits, and external stakeholders.
    Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience from aviation, airports, aerospace, defence or another safety-critical field is highly valued. Knowledge of flight safety, airspace coordination, Seveso, explosive materials, ADR, or systematic fire protection is an advantage.

You are an analytical and confident leader who remains calm under pressure. You combine structure and integrity with a practical approach and are comfortable making difficult decisions when safety is at stake. You also know how to build trust, challenge unsafe practices, and turn requirements into effective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead and develop the overall safety function and Safety Management System at Esrange.
    Ensure clear safety frameworks, processes, and responsibilities.
    Coordinate the Esrange Safety Board and safety preparations for launches, tests and campaigns.
    Lead and coordinate safety specialists across range safety, flight safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
    Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits and authority requirements.
    Develop the site-wide crisis and emergency response organization, including training and exercises.
    Coordinate airspace, impact-area and public-safety matters with authorities and external stakeholders.
    Oversee incident management, safety planning, budgeting and continuous improvement.

WE OFFER YOU

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position is security-sensitive and requires approved security vetting and background check in accordance with the protective security act. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.title: Piping Team Leader
jobs.description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Team Leaders. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Team Leader is responsible for supervising and coordinating all piping installation and maintenance activities on site. This role involves leading a team of piping fitters and related personnel to ensure piping systems are installed, assembled, and maintained according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Team Leader ensures work is completed efficiently, safely, and within project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and supervise piping crews, including piping fitters and support personnel, during installation and maintenance activities.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, piping isometrics, and technical specifications.

· Plan, organize, and assign daily work activities to ensure project schedules and deadlines are met.

· Oversee installation, alignment, and assembly of piping systems, valves, pumps, and associated equipment.

· Ensure proper pipe routing, supports, fittings, and installation methods in accordance with engineering requirements.

· Monitor work progress and ensure high standards of quality and workmanship.

· Coordinate with welding teams, mechanical crews, engineers, and supervisors to ensure smooth project execution.

· Conduct routine inspections of piping installations and ensure compliance with project specifications and industry standards.

· Ensure all work activities comply with company safety policies, site safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Identify and resolve technical or installation issues that arise during project execution.

· Maintain records of work progress, manpower utilization, and materials usage.

· Provide technical guidance, training, and support to piping crew members when necessary.

Qualifications

· Experience in piping installation and maintenance in industrial, construction, or plant environments is preferred.

· Experience as a Piping Fitter or similar role, with leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

· Strong ability to read and interpret piping drawings, isometric drawings, and technical documentation.

· Knowledge of piping materials, fittings, valves, installation techniques, and industry standards.

· Understanding of safety procedures and construction site practices.

Skills and Competencies

· Leadership and team management skills

· Strong technical knowledge of piping systems

· Planning and organizational ability

· Problem-solving and decision-making skills

· Strong communication and coordination skills

· Commitment to quality and safety standards

jobs.title: Program Controller to premium EV brand!
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical controller with a passion for the automotive industry and product lifecycles? Do you thrive in cross-functional, international environments where your financial insights directly shape key strategic decisions? Then this might be your next opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Program Controller to join our client, a leading global premium EV brand. This positions is located in Gothenburg.

In this role, you will hold a key position supporting the development and financial steering of vehicle programs throughout key program milestones. You will work closely with Program Management and cross-functional stakeholders—including R&D, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Office, Volume Planning, and Finance—to ensure financial transparency and drive efficient program execution. The position uniquely combines program controlling across the full product lifecycle with financial controlling within a major automotive group, covering joint venture production and strategic sister-brand operations. providing broad exposure to both program and product cost controlling. You will also engage in close cooperation with international counterparts.

Your daily tasks

    Drive and communicate the financial progression of model year programs against established targets and milestones
    Serve as a key financial partner to program management, providing quality-assured financial data to support decision-making throughout the program lifecycle
    Act as the primary contact for program-related financial matters, both within Finance and towards operational stakeholders
    Secure, analyze, and deliver investment (CAPEX), cost, and profitability data for program milestones, including clear explanations of variances and underlying business drivers
    Actively participate in all financial planning processes, including Forecasts, Budget, and Business Planning (BPL), covering investment spend and vehicle profitability
    Lead financial controlling activities for manufacturing plants, ensuring robust reporting, analyses, and financial performance assessments aligned with business realities
    Perform financial analyses of transfer prices from manufacturing plants in close collaboration with transfer pricing controllers
    Drive and support business case development and investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost improvement initiatives, and cost reduction tracking

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you possess a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business insights. jobs.title: PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are offering a PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level commencing 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

Our group and research
The hired PhD student will join the research group Data & Modelling which currently has 9 members, including one research assistant, two PhD students, and 6 associate professors. Our research group is focused advanced methods for monitoring and modelling data from animal production systems. This includes the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods.

Project description
The PhD project will be focused on developing, assessing, and comparing traditional and modern ML and AI methods in terms of their utility and practicality for monitoring diverse types of time series data recorded at the levels of herds, groups of animals, and individual animals. The project will be based on already available data sets, and the collection of new data is not expected to be a part of this project.

The data sets will include

  • Herd level input and production data with the aims of estimating e.g. infection status or environmental impact
  • Sensor data record on or around individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns
  • Video data recorded of individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns
The ML/AI methods will include

  • Traditional time series modelling, specifically dynamic linear models (a type of state space model)
  • Neural network-based time series models, specifically transformers
  • Convolutional neural networks, for encoding video frames
  • Closed frontier large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini)
  • Small open weights models to be run locally (e.g. Qwen3.5-9B, OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, Mistral Ministral 3 8B Reasoning)
The exact combinations of data sets and methods will depend on the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

Principal supervisor is Associate professor Dan Børge Jensen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, daj@sund.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +4535333021.

Duration: 3 years as a PhD student + 3 months as research assistant for enrolment


Job description
Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

  • Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.
  • Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team.
  • Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project
  • Teaching and disseminating your knowledge.
  • Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
PhD Programme Description:
The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Anima Science).

Qualifications:
If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

The successful candidate should further be able to demonstrate the following:

  • Mastery of the R language for statistical computing
  • Practical experience with the Keras and Tensorflow R packages
  • Practical experience with state space models (e.g. dynamic linear models) for time series modelling
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating fully connected artificial neural networks
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating convolutional neural networks
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating transformer neural networks
  • Practical experience with the use of large language models via API calls
Other important criteria are:

  • The grade point average achieved
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Previous publications
  • Relevant work experience
  • Other professional activities
  • A curious mind-set with a strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
  • Language skills
Place of employment

The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and modern computer hardware for training artificial neural networks.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree.

Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

Questions
For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science

4. Publication list (if possible)

Application deadline: 7 October 2026, 23.59pm CEST.

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Interviews are expected to be held in week 45 or 46.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aarhus?

 Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aarhus.

 Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

 Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

 Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

  Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

 Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

 Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

 Stillingen er på fuld tid og er som udgangspunkt et barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

 Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Trindsøvej i Aarhus.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aarhus og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aarhus". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores afdelingsdirektør Niels Juul Jørgensen på tlf. 4040 2489 eller mail nju@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.description:
Om stillinga 

Gulen kommune har ledig to i inntil 100% faste stillingar som sjukepleiar ved Sone Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra (Sone BBD) frå snarast/etter avtale. Desse stillingane er for tida knytt til rullerande todelt turnus på 12 veker i Brekke. Den eine faste stillinga har arbeid med langvakter 4. kvar helg og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. Den andre faste stillinga har langvakter kvar 4. helg og kombinasjon av langvakter og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. 

Ta kontakt med kontaktperson i annonsen dersom du har spørsmål til stillingane/turnus. 

Sone BBD har ansvar for heimetenestene i områda Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra. 

Me tilbyr

  • Spanande stillingar i ei teneste i utvikling. Rom for å kunne bidra aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet  
  • Bonusordning på 100 000kr (i 100% stilling) ved binding i 2 år i desse stillingane. Bonus vert som hovudregel betalt ut på slutten av bindingstida, om ikkje anna vert avtalt
  • Løn over tariff for sjukepleiarar i turnus
  • Ekstra helgekompensasjon ved gått vakt 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar

Arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Sjukepleiefagleg ansvar og oppgåver
  • Pasientretta oppgåver, som til dømes pleie og oppfølging av brukarane
  • Samarbeid med andre faggrupper, 2. linjeteneste m.fl.
  • Andre oppgåver som måtte kome til

I sone BBD arbeider det både nyutdanna og tilsette med lang erfaring. Det er eit tett og godt samarbeid mellom assistentar, fagarbeidarar og sjukepleiarar/vernepleiarar kvar dag. Samarbeidet er viktig for at tenestene våre skal verte best mogleg for innbyggjarane i Gulen kommune, og noko me har fokus på kontinuerleg


Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Autorisasjon som sjukepleiar
  • Gode norskkunnskapar - både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Gyldig politiattest 
  • Førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Er fleksibel og kommuniserer/samhandlar godt med brukarar/pårørande og kollegaer
  • Vert motivert av å yte gode tenester til brukarane, og kan vere med å gje dei ein stabil og god kvardag
  • Kan bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og har fokus på kvalitet og faglig utvikling
  • Tar initiativ, er strukturert, fleksibel og har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Å vere personleg eigna kan verte vektlagt ved tilsetjing

Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk
  • Tilsetjing etter gjeldande lover, føresegner og avtalar 
  • For tilsetjing innan pleie og omsorg, miljøteneste, barnevern, i skule, SFO og i barnehage, vert det stilt krav om politiattest etter aktuell/gjeldande lovheimel før oppstart i stillinga. Det skal berre krevjast politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga
  • Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlister med namn, kjønn, alder og noverande stilling er offentleg informasjon. Dersom søkjarar likevel ber om konfidensiell handsaming, og grunnen for å unnta offentleggjering ikkje vert godkjent, får søkjaren høve til å trekke søknaden sin før offentleggjering

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen.

Kommunen har 2301 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.
