jobs.title: Gryning söker enhetschef till Bergiusgården i Ljungskile
jobs.description:
Ägs av kommuner – drivs av engagemang! I 25år har Gryning erbjudit HVB- och öppenvård för barn, ungdomar och familjer, jour- och familjehem, beroendevård, lägenheter med stöd, insatser mot hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck samt LSS-boende. Vi erbjuder rådgivning och utbildning samt hjälper till med placeringar. Gryning ägs av kommunerna i Västra Götaland via de fyra kommunalförbunden.

Bergiusgården tar emot ungdomar mellan 16-21 år med missbruksproblematik, där vi erbjuder heldygnsomsorg och kvalificerad behandling. Ungdomarna placeras enligt SOL eller LVU. Vår huvuduppgift är att tillsammans med ungdomen och hens nätverk möjliggöra ett förändringsarbete i en trygg och stabil miljö där vi strävar efter att bidra till förändrade, förbättrade och varaktiga livsvillkor för den unge.

Vi söker nu dig som enhetschef som tillsammans med Gryning vill utveckla verksamheten på Bergius!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vad innebär tjänsten?

Verksamheten vilar på ett miljöterapeutiskt förhållningssätt där struktur och relation är centrala delar. Vi arbetar med lågaffektivt bemötande, där MI genomsyrar både samtal och vardagligt förhållningssätt och vi utgår från traumamedveten omsorg i allt vi gör. Som enhetschef för Bergiusgården har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetens kvalitet, ekonomi, personal och arbetsmiljö. Du leder, planerar och följer upp verksamheten med fokus på hög kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt.

I rollen ingår även ansvar för kundkontakter, samverkan med uppdragsgivare och myndigheter samt arbete med verksamhets- och metodutveckling. Du har många både interna och externa kontaktytor och samverkar nära kollegor inom Gryning.

Tjänsten ger dig chans att påverka både struktur, kultur och arbetssätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vem är du?

Du är en trygg, tydlig och engagerande ledare med förmåga att skapa delaktighet och driva verksamheten mot uppsatta mål. Du arbetar strukturerat, har god planeringsförmåga och är van att följa upp och utveckla verksamhet och medarbetare. Ditt ledarskap präglas av lyhördhet, lösningsfokus och ett genuint engagemang för både personal och målgrupp.

Du har akademisk examen, exempelvis som socionom, socialpedagog, beteendevetare eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Då du som enhetschef ansvarar för verksamhetens tillstånd behöver du uppfylla IVO:s krav på relevant högskoleutbildning samt erfarenhet från liknande verksamhet. Det är meriterande om du har arbetslivserfarenhet av aktuell målgrupp.

Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är kommunikativ och har förmågan att inspirera till engagemang och ansvarstagande. Tjänsten innebär resor och kräver därför körkort. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Vi erbjuder

·         Engagerade chefskollegor med bred kompetens och en utvecklande ledningsgrupp

·         En kultur som präglas av kunskap, kvalitet och delaktighet

·         Handledning, chefsutveckling, kompetensutveckling och olika former av medarbetardialoger

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!  

Urval och intervjuande sker löpande så välkommen med din ansökan redan i dag.

Innan anställning görs utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret samt fördjupad bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna rekrytering.

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska till geriatriken i Bromma
jobs.description:
Geriatriken på Stockholms Sjukhem är en av de största geriatriska klinikerna i regionen med drygt 370 anställda medarbetare och drygt 7000 vårdtillfällen per år. Verksamheten erbjuder akutgeriatrisk vård och rehabilitering med intag dygnet runt och bedriver även kognitiv mottagning. Vården bedrivs i multiprofessionella team i nära samarbete mellan personal, patient och närstående. Hos oss är delaktighet, utveckling och kvalité fokusområden.

Din roll som sjuksköterskaI samarbete med undersköterskor, läkare och paramedicinska yrkesgrupper ansvarar du för att utföra både basal och specifik omvårdnad, förebygga risker och hantera akuta situationer. I ditt arbete möter du allmängeriatriska patienter med olika diagnoser så som frakturer, stroke och/eller infektioner. Du har alltid nära stöd i dina kollegor och chef men arbetets art bygger på att du ska kunna fatta egna beslut och agera självständigt om situationen kräver, då du som sjuksköterska leder arbetet på avdelningen.

Hos oss får du

    en gedigen introduktion
    en familjär, positiv och inkluderande arbetsplats där vi lär av varandra
    kompetensutveckling med tillgång till interna och externa utbildningar
    en närvarande, lyhörd och engagerad chef
    ett grymt-roligt och professionellt team!

Är du vår nya kollega?

Krav för tjänsten är att du är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med erfarenhet av sjukvård och gärna geriatrisk vård, samt har goda kunskaper i svenska tal och skrift. Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper och vi söker dig som:

    är trygg och självständig i din profession
    trivs med den variation som arbetet erbjuder i kombination med att du är lösningsorienterad i din natur
    har ett mjukt och respektfullt bemötande samt har en förmåga att på ett naturligt sätt etablera en god relation till patient och närstående

Låter detta som du? Då kommer du att trivas med oss och vi med dig! Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Om tjänsten och ansökan

Tjänsten är heltid dag, tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och 6 månaders provanställning.

Urvalet hanteras löpande. Har du ytterligare frågor om tjänsten besvaras de av enhetschef geraitrik joanna.grauers@stockholmssjukhem.se eller Maryam Kahurzadeh, maryam.kahurzadeh@stockholmssjukhem.se.

Vi arbetar för en trygg och säker hälso- och sjukvård. Därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess och innan anställning. Kontrollerna kan variera beroende på roll. På vår informationssida kan du läsa mer om vilka kontroller som ingår.

Stockholms Sjukhem arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens för att främja att vi är en arbetsplats för alla.  Vi har tagit ställning till annonsering, vilket gör att vi inte önskar säljsamtal för ytterligare frågor kring annonsering, rekrytering eller bemanning.

Stockholms Sjukhem är en av Sveriges största idéburna vårdgivare. Vi erbjuder ett brett vårdutbud inom geriatrik, rehabilitering, palliativ vård och äldreomsorg. Att bedriva sjukvård och äldreomsorg är ett stort samhällsansvar och som godkänd universitetssjukvårdsenhet arbetar vi ständigt med forskning, utveckling och utbildning. Hos oss arbetar du i en varm miljö som värdesätter det personliga bemötandet och kännetecknas av värdeorden engagemang, kunskap och omtanke.

jobs.title: Slaughter Operatives Tican Fresh Meat A/S, Thisted and Brørup  We’re Hiring Slaughter Operatives
jobs.description:
Tican Fresh Meat A/S is owned by the Tönnies Group, one of the world’s largest food companies. 95% of our production is exported, mainly to Germany and distant markets. The factory in both Thisted and Brørup employs around 1400 people in total. The major part is slaughter operatives.  Tican is a company with deep roots and traditions, and our history dates back to 1928.

We are in the lookout for new colleagues who want an exciting future in an international food group and are willing to help develop the company. Among other things, we are investing in increased automation so that our colleagues have the best possible platform for carrying out their daily tasks. Above all, we are a company of #butchers, #meatjobs, #diversity and #agoodplacetobe.

We are looking for different employee categories. Knife experience and butchery skills would be an advantage. It is an advantage if you speak Danish or English, German or Polish, but not a requirement. You preferably have experience in the food industry.

We are especially on the lookout for experienced knife workers, slaughter operatives for the butchery chain, and also slaughter operative for cutting/boning.

We offer:

·        An exciting and challenging workplace with excellent conditions

·        Good, solid training

·        Dynamic collaboration with talented colleagues

·        Opportunities for professional and personal development

ü  An attractive salary package starting as soon as possible ?

ü  Good colleagues  

We expect you to:

·        Be at least 18 years old

·        Have an efficient work style and thrive in an active and cheerful department

·        Be serious and stable in terms of attendance

You will be part of the existing team with a 37-hour working week in Brorup, or a 42,5 hour week in Thisted according to a local agreement.  The workplace is Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup, Denmark or Strandvejen 7, 7700 Thisted ,Denmark

Contact:

Please send your application by e-mail to job@tican.dk, subject Knife workers, slaughter operative “ Brørup” or “ Thisted “

Applications are assessed on an ongoing basis and positions will be filled as soon as we have found the right candidates.      

Tican Fresh Meat A/S is locally known beyond all borders. Read more on the website www.tican.dk.

jobs.title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADA

About the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:

    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.
    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.
    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.
    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.
    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.
    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.
    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Ainola Kauneusklinikka, Helsinki

Haluaisitko olla osa energistä ja intohimoa täynnä olevaa tiimiä Helsingin keskustassa? Ainola Kauneusklinikka, joka on erikoistunut kokonaisvaltaisiin kauneus- ja kosmetologipalveluihin, on kasvattanut asiakaskuntaansa merkittävästi vuoden 2015 avaamisesta lähtien. Tällä hetkellä meillä on jo noin 10 000 aktiivista kanta-asiakasta. Nyt haemme tiimiimme asiakkuuspäällikköä tukemaan kasvua ja kehitystämme.

Tehtäväsi sisältää:

- Klinikkamme palveluiden ja tuotteiden esittelyn sekä myynnin

- Näytehoitojen tekemisen uusille asiakkaille

- Asiakkaiden neuvonnan ja ohjauksen heidän tarpeidensa mukaisesti

- Yhteistyön tiimin kanssa palveluiden kehittämisessä


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Takuupalkka 20€ / tunti

- Säännölliset työajat (21-30 tuntia/viikko)

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan koulutuksen, jotta pääset alkuun varmasti

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä huippuosaajaksi innovatiivisilla tuotteilla ja moderneilla laitteilla

- Kannustavan ja energisen työilmapiirin, jossa tiimityö on keskiössä

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja bonukset


Etsimme sinua, jolla on:

- Into kauneudenhoitoalaan ja halu kehittyä alan ammattilaiseksi

- Vahvat sosiaaliset taidot ja positiivinen asenne

- Rohkeus toimia itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti

- Sujuva suomen kielen taito


Eduksi näemme:

- Kauneudenhoitoalan kokemusta tai koulutusta

- Kaupallista tai asiakaspalvelukokemusta

- Kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä

- Englannin, ruotsin tai venäjän kielen taitoja


Tervetuloa mukaan Ainola Kauneusklinikan tiimiin, jossa yhdistämme intohimon kauneudenhoitoon, asiakaslähtöisen palvelun ja uudistumisen halun.

jobs.title: Produktionstekniker - FLIR!
jobs.description:
Gillar du att skruva, justera och lösa problem när en maskin inte beter sig som den ska? Då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

WeStaff Sweden söker nu en tekniskt nyfiken och praktiskt lagd person till FLIR i Täby. Här får du en vardag där du är nära maskinerna, produktionen och människorna som arbetar med dem.

Det här är en roll för dig som hellre tar fram verktygslådan än sitter still framför ett skrivbord. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, det viktiga är att du tycker om teknik, vill förstå hur saker fungerar och gillar att hitta lösningar.

Om FLIR

På FLIR i Täby tillverkas avancerade optiska komponenter som används i bland annat värmekameror och andra produkter inom avancerad sensorteknik.

Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av den dagliga produktionen och arbetar med utrustningen som gör tillverkningen möjlig. Ena stunden kan du behöva undersöka varför en maskin stannat, nästa stund justera en komponent eller hjälpa en operatör att få igång utrustningen igen.

En stor del av rollen handlar om att vara nyfiken och metodisk: Vad har hänt? Varför händer det? Vad behöver justeras eller åtgärdas för att maskinen ska fungera igen?

Du arbetar både med planerat underhåll och med problem som behöver lösas här och nu. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att lära dig mer om avancerade maskiner och processer inom precisionsproduktion.

En vardag nära tekniken

I rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

    

Felsökning när produktionsutrustning inte fungerar som den ska

    

Förebyggande underhåll och enklare service

    

Justering och byte av mekaniska komponenter

    

Mekanik, pneumatik och enklare el

    

CNC-maskiner och annan precisionsutrustning

    

Slip-, poler- och rengöringsutrustning

    

Kontroller och funktionskontroller av maskiner

    

Dokumentation av underhåll och genomförda åtgärder

    

Installation och uppstart av ny utrustning

    

Förbättringar av maskiner, arbetssätt och processer

    

Teknisk support till operatörer och produktion

Du kommer alltså inte att göra samma sak varje dag. Rollen innebär variation och mycket kontakt med både utrustning och kollegor.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Vi tror att du kan ha många olika vägar in i rollen.

Kanske har du arbetat som industrimekaniker, underhållstekniker, servicetekniker, CNC-tekniker, maskinoperatör eller produktionstekniker. Kanske har du en teknisk utbildning och har upptäckt att det är när du får arbeta praktiskt som du trivs som bäst. Det vi framför allt letar efter är en person som:

    

Är praktiskt lagd och tycker om att arbeta med händerna

    

Har ett genuint tekniskt intresse

    

Gillar att felsöka och lösa problem

    

Har grundläggande kunskaper inom mekanik

    

Har erfarenhet av industri, produktion, service eller underhåll

    

Är bekväm med att använda verktyg och teknisk utrustning

    

Kan läsa och förstå tekniska instruktioner och enklare ritningar

    

Har grundläggande datorvana

    

Behärskar svenska och engelska

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från optikbranschen. Har du arbetat med CNC, finmekanik, precisionsmaskiner, medicinteknik eller annan tekniskt avancerad produktion är det ett stort plus, men det är din tekniska förståelse och vilja att lära som väger tyngst.

Vi erbjuder dig

    

Ett spännande uppdrag hos ett innovativt teknikföretag

    

Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad optik- och sensorteknik

    

En modern arbetsmiljö med hög teknisk kompetens

    

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom underhåll och maskinteknik

    

Goda möjligheter till ett långsiktigt uppdrag för rätt person

    

Anställning hos WeStaff Sweden med kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Praktisk information

Tjänst: Produktionstekniker Omfattning: Heltid Arbetstid: Dagtid, mån-fre Plats: Täby/Arninge Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

Om WeStaff Sweden AB

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

Company description:

NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world.

Job description:

Build early commercial partnerships across the data centre marketWould you like to shape how NKT engages with customers across the growing data centre segment? As Director, Business Development Data Centers, you will establish early commercial relationships, develop qualified opportunities and coordinate a OneNKT approach across business lines. This international role offers the opportunity to support NKT’s growth journey while contributing to the infrastructure needed for the green transition.

Develop strategic data centre opportunities across selected marketsYou will manage front-end business development across the data centre ecosystem, engaging customers and partners before formal tendering begins. By understanding customer priorities and coordinating internal stakeholders, you will help shape commercial positioning and prepare qualified opportunities for handover to the relevant business line. You will also contribute to NKT’s data centre go-to-market strategy and provide structured insights into market dynamics, customer needs, competitors and portfolio gaps.Your responsibility will be to:


    Map and prioritise target customers, projects and decision-makers
    Build relationships with developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators and OEMs
    Develop and manage qualified opportunities through early customer engagement
    Coordinate customer activities across NKT business lines and functions
    Support partnership discussions, market analysis and management updates

The position may be based in London, Runcorn, Teesside, Cologne, Berlin, Malmö, Karlskrona or Copenhagen. Planned travel of more than 50 days per year is expected, including customer meetings, industry forums and partner discussions.

Profile description:

Commercial relationship builder with a collaborative working styleYou communicate clearly with people at different organisational levels and create trust through a consistent and considered approach. You are comfortable working across functions, balancing several stakeholder perspectives and maintaining structure as opportunities develop. Curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to translate discussions into practical next steps will help you work effectively in an international and matrix-based organisation.You also have:




    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
    Experience in business development, strategic sales, key account management or go-to-market roles within electrical infrastructure, electrical components or power solutions
    Experience with complex solution selling
    Established network and experience within the data centre ecosystem, including developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators or OEMs
    A record of developing senior external and internal relationships and early-stage commercial opportunities
    Fluent English



Connect data centre growth with the green transitionWe aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This role offers opportunities for professional development in a collaborative, international setting. You will expand your knowledge of the data centre value chain, work with colleagues across several business lines and develop your commercial and strategic capabilities. You will also contribute to NKT’s market approach within a growing infrastructure segment connected to the green transition.“As a leader, I believe in giving you the freedom to manage tasks while being available to support you when needed. I appreciate work-life balance and aim to build an environment that supports it", says Hiring Manager, Simone Pagliuca







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 7th of October. Please submit your application in English. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests will be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Global Talent Attraction Specialist, Angelina Nilsson at Angelina.nilsson@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.



We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.



Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.title: BMS Project Manager for Datacenter Projects
jobs.description:
We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

What We Are Looking For:

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Good written and spoken English communication skills
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area
* Valid right to work in Finland
* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Electrical Safety Card

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

Interested?

Apply through the application link and submit your CV and salary expectations. A brief application letter is optional.

Apply as soon as possible, as interviews have already started and suitable candidates may be selected during the application period.

For data security reasons, we do not accept applications via email.

For further information, please contact:

Leevi Rantalainen, leevi.rantalainen@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 480 2914
Miia Koivula, miia.koivula@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 193 0347

With offices in 80 countries, Manpower is one of the largest contingent and permanent staffing firms globally, and the market leader in the Nordic and Baltic countries. In Finland we are one of the largest companies specializing in recruitment, temporary staffing and assessments. We help employers find competent and motivated professionals for interim and permanent positions at all organizational levels. We serve our clients and candidates across the nation.

jobs.title: Industriële Schilders
jobs.description:
Het uitvoeren van industriële schilder‑ en oppervlaktebehandelingswerkzaamheden met als doel het duurzaam beschermen van industriële installaties, staalconstructies, machines, leidingen en opslagtanks tegen corrosie, chemicaliën, slijtage en overige invloeden. Dit gebeurt volgens geldende veiligheidsnormen, kwaliteitsrichtlijnen en projectspecificaties.

Verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Voorbereiden van oppervlakken door reinigen, ontvetten, schuren (manueel of machinaal) en stralen.
  • Aanbrengen van primers, laklagen, epoxy‑coatings, polyurethaan‑coatings en andere beschermsystemen.
  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles zoals droge en natte laagdiktemetingen, visuele inspecties en hechtingscontroles, temperatuur- en luchtvochtigheidsmetingen en ruwheidsmetingen.
  • Correct instellen en bedienen van schilder-, straal‑ en spuitapparatuur.
  • Afdekken en beschermen van niet‑te‑behandelen zones.
  • Signaleren van afwijkingen, beschadigingen of corrosieproblemen en uitvoeren van herstelwerkzaamheden.
  • Registreren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en gebruikte materialen.
  • Werken volgens veiligheidsinstructies (VCA), inclusief correcte inzet van PBM’s.
  • Eventueel ondersteunen bij brandwerende, chemisch resistente of hygiënische coatings.
  • In teamverband samenwerken met (meewerkende) voormannen en inspecteurs.

Je hebt geen hoogtevrees en je bent een echte teamplayer. Je bent bereid om nieuwe zaken te leren zodat je op rustigere momenten multidisciplinair inzetbaar bent.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? Do you have a background in electric power systems and are you interested in risk-based power system operation? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Department of Electric Energy (IEL) at NTNU is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time (100%) PhD position for 3 years in “Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity”. You will join the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA) at IEL, where we foster an open, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.

Our working environment is characterized by a friendly, supportive atmosphere, with regular gatherings such as professional meetings within the research group, weekly research colloquia, shared lunches, and “Friday coffee” sessions to wrap up the week. Formal and informal gatherings provide opportunities to exchange ideas, celebrate milestones, and strengthen connections. PhD Candidates also arrange social activities, open to everyone who wishes to join, creating a welcoming and inclusive community.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.


About the project

The PhD position is a part of the Knowledge-building Project “Increasing Emergency Load Limits for Transformers” (KSP UPLOAD) that is starting up in 2027. SINTEF Energy Research is the project owner.  NTNU is a participating partner, together with leading industry partners. Hiring for the PhD position is subject to the final confirmation of funding availability from KSP UPLOAD.

Liquid-immersed power transformers are critical power grid assets. Due to an ageing power grid, growing demand for electricity, and very long lead times on installing new transformers, there is a need to both increase the utilization of existing infrastructure of transformers and to maximise the value of new investments. Increasing the short-term load limits for transformers will free up capacity to accommodate new load and generation, reduce the need for reinvestments, and provide back-up capacity in case of emergency. Improved methods for condition monitoring and prediction, along with better risk criteria can reduce uncertainties and offer a possibility for increasing the transformer loading. KSP UPLOAD will investigate key failure mechanisms for transformers, map the benefits and risks of increasing the load and temperature limits, and pilot new concepts for risk control. 

The PhD Position belongs to Work Package 1 of KSP UPLOAD: ‘System-level Benefits and Risks in from Increased Loading’. It addresses the question of how to quantify the socio-economic benefits, as well as the risk with respect to reliability of supply, when operating transformers beyond nameplate limits. 

The tasks meant for the PhD work are related to:  

  • Quantifying how higher loading limits affect the socio-economic trade-off between reliability of supply and making additional capacity available to power markets with flow-based market coupling.
  • Developing methods for optimally allocating the additional transfer capability enabled by increased transformer loading limits across day-ahead, intraday, and balancing markets to maximize socio-economic value while respecting system security and reliability constraints.

Different approaches can be explored, such as integrating probabilistic and deterministic reliability criteria with market operation in a single security-constrained optimal power flow model, and combining optimal power flow analysis with reliability analysis methods.

The main supervisor of the PhD Candidate will be Associate Professor Vijay Venu Vadlamudi (IEL). Co-supervisors will be Professor Hossein Farahmand (IEL) and Senior Research Scientist Iver Bakken Sperstad (SINTEF Energy Research). 


Duties of the position
  • Conduct high-quality research within the framework described above.
  • Participate in activities of the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA).
  • Complete academic training consisting of coursework corresponding to a minimum of 30 ECTS.
  • Contribute to publications in relevant journals and to popular science dissemination.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions.

Career-enhancing work, which is in addition to the research project and doctoral education, may be offered to a candidate who demonstrates clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department determines there is a need. Examples of career-enhancing work include, but are not limited to, contributing to teaching, laboratory and exercise teaching, supervision, and examination work within the employee's areas of competence. 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must hold a Master’s degree within Electric Power Engineering, with specialization in electric power and/or energy systems. 
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the Master's level. Master's students can apply, but the Master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position, and no later than autumn 2026.
  • You must have proficient programming skills in Python.
  • Employment is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to obtain the required security clearance.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, i.e., by having relevant work experience and/or published/publishable scientific papers.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0 
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills and the ability to communicate fluently will be conducted in the continued selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Master’s thesis relevant to the announced position.
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish), both written and spoken, at B2 level or higher is considered an advantage. The candidate is expected to collaborate with stakeholders in the Norwegian industry and utility sectors, where Norwegian is the working language.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in their work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in their research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Social activities organized by PhD Students
  • Weekly social gathering on Fridays (Friday coffee)
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)  
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.  

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of an additional 3 to 12 months of employment related to career-enhancing activities. 

The option for career-enhancing work may be offered to a candidate who has clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department deems it necessary. This will be clarified with the candidate during and after any interview.  

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Electric Power Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant describes personal motivation, summarizes scientific work, and explains how the applicant sees her/his background as suitable (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages, including references). This proposal will be neither final nor binding for the project.
  • CV.
  • If you have testimonials of work experience, submit them.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not yet completed your Master's thesis, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the submission of the Master's thesis, or confirmation that your Master's thesis has been submitted.
    • Applicants from universities outside Norway are requested to send a diploma supplement or a similar document, which describes in detail the study programme and grading system.
  • A copy of the Master's thesis. If you recently submitted your Master's thesis, you are encouraged to attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology

About the Role:

We are seeking a structured and commercially minded Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology to join our team.

In this role, you will support company management and ongoing green technology projects by combining project coordination, business analysis, quantitative modelling, technical research, and operational administration.

Working closely with management and project stakeholders, you will organize project information, maintain yield and cost models, evaluate scenarios, support financial and commercial analysis, and translate operational data into structured business information and decision-support material.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Coordination

Support company management with ongoing commercial and technical projects, including tracking deliverables, action points, schedules, project information and administrative follow-ups.

Quantitative Excel Modelling

Develop and maintain Excel-based calculation models and prototypes for process yields, quantities, volumes, pricing, costs, revenues and other project-related calculations.

Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis

Prepare scenario, sensitivity and comparative calculations to assess how changes in operational assumptions may affect commercial outcomes, costs, risks and project viability.

Process & Technical Data Analysis

Research and analyze information relating to thermolysis/pyrolysis processes, feedstocks, process outputs and relevant by-products, and incorporate relevant data into commercial and financial models.

Commercial Data Translation

Translate technical and operational assumptions into practical commercial models, business cases, analyses and presentations suitable for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Content Development

Prepare and maintain technical, commercial and administrative documentation, reports, presentations, visual materials and other project-related content.

Financial Administration

Support general financial administration, preliminary bookkeeping, invoice verification, cost tracking and project budget follow-ups.

Digital & Information Management

Maintain and organize project information through SharePoint and other digital systems, and assist with maintaining the company's website and LinkedIn presence.

Operational & Management Support

Provide direct administrative and operational support to company management and act as a coordination point for information flow between management, project teams and external contacts.

Qualifications & Experience

    Relevant professional experience in project coordination, business analysis, business administration, operations, financial administration or a related field.
    Demonstrated experience working with Microsoft Excel, including developing and maintaining quantitative calculation models.
    Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to work with operational, commercial and financial data.
    Ability to translate operational and process data into structured commercial and financial analysis.
    Strong organizational, administrative and project coordination skills.
    Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and follow up on details.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Ability to prepare clear professional documentation, presentations and visual materials.
    Experience with SharePoint, digital content management, website administration and LinkedIn/social media is an advantage.
    Familiarity with or interest in green technology, circular economy, thermolysis/pyrolysis processes and their products and by-products is an advantage.

The position requires a versatile and technically curious professional who can combine administrative, analytical, technical and communication responsibilities and work closely with company management.

jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Supported Long-Term Hydropower Scheduling
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? Do you have a background in electrical power engineering, operations research, or a related field, and are you interested in energy systems and markets? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, both in and outside academia. 

The Department of Electric Energy (IEL) at NTNU is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time (100%) PhD position for 3 years as part of the Norwegian Centre on AI for Decisions. You will join the research group Electricity Markets and Energy System Planning (EMESP) at IEL, where we foster an open, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.

Our work environment is defined by its friendly and supportive atmosphere, with regular gatherings such as professional meetings within the research group, weekly colloquia, shared lunches, and “Friday coffee” sessions to end the week. These formal and informal events offer opportunities to share ideas, celebrate milestones, and build relationships. PhD candidates also organize social activities open to everyone interested, fostering a welcoming and inclusive community.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.


About the project

The position will be part of AID, the Norwegian Centre on AI for Decisions, an interdisciplinary national AI centre led by NTNU and SINTEF. AID brings together academic institutions, research organizations, and more than 50 professional organizations. Its primary objective is to advance AI for decision-making through fundamental research and real-world use cases, ensuring that AI-enhanced human decisions and autonomous systems are effective, safe, and trustworthy in sectors critical to society.

This PhD project will contribute to AID by developing trustworthy AI-supported methods for long-term hydropower scheduling. Hydropower plays a central role in the Nordic power system, and deciding when to use or store water is becoming increasingly important as the energy system faces more uncertainty from weather, renewable generation, market developments, and future electricity demand. These decisions depend on uncertain inflows, future electricity prices, reservoir levels, cascade constraints, and the nonlinear relationship between water release and electricity production. Improving such decisions is essential for efficient renewable energy use, energy security, and the reliable operation of hydro-dominated power systems.

The project will focus on how AI can support advanced optimization models for hydropower and energy-system planning. In particular, the research will investigate how the future value of stored water can be represented more accurately when hydropower production is nonlinear and when short-term operational conditions influence long-term reservoir decisions. In line with AID’s research areas, the project will emphasize trust, knowledge embedding, generalization under uncertainty, and human-interpretable decision support.

The PhD candidate will develop and validate a hybrid methodology that combines established stochastic optimization with AI-based learning. The aim is not only to develop new algorithms, but also to understand how AI can be used safely and reliably in decision-support tools for the energy sector. The enhanced framework will be tested on Nordic hydropower use cases, including long-term and medium-term hydropower scheduling, multi-reservoir cascade operation, hydropower participation in energy and reserve markets, and planning under high renewable variability. In this way, the project responds to the growing need for safe and trustworthy AI tools in demanding, decision-critical systems.

The PhD candidate will be hosted in the Electricity Markets and Energy Systems Planning (EMESP) group at the Department of Electric Energy, NTNU. The main supervisor will be Professor Hossein Farahmand, with co-supervision from experts in stochastic hydropower optimization and AI for decision-making, including Professor Arild Helseth, Associate Professor Jayaprakash Rajasekharan, Professor Sebastien Gros, and Research Manager Signe Riemer-Sørensen, depending on the final methodological focus of the PhD project.


Duties of the position
  • Carry out research of high quality within the framework described above
  • Participate in activities of the EMESP research group 
  • Complete academic training consisting of coursework corresponding to a minimum 30 ECTS
  • Contribute to publications in relevant journals and to popular science dissemination
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions 

Career-enhancing work, which is in addition to the research project and doctoral education, may be offered to a candidate who demonstrates clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department determines there is a need. Examples of career-enhancing work include, but are not limited to, contributing to teaching, laboratory and exercise teaching, supervision, and examination work within the employee's areas of competence. 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in either electrical power engineering, computer science, control engineering, chemistry, managerial economics with strong quantitative skills, or physics or mathematics with a specialization in operations research. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than autumn 2026.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, i.e., by having relevant work experience and/or published/publishable scientific papers.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • Experience with optimization modelling and numerical optimization tools, such as JuMP, Pyomo, Gurobi, CPLEX, HiGHS, or similar frameworks and solvers, will be considered an important qualification.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. This can be done through an approved English language test. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0 
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills, as well as the ability to communicate fluently, will be conducted throughout the selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Work and/or research experience in electricity markets, hydropower scheduling, energy system modeling, and operations research or optimization.
  • Very good programming and modeling skills, preferably in Julia, Python, or a similar programming language.
  • Knowledge and/or experience with Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, AI-based time-series forecasting
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), the candidate is expected to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in their work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in their research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal and interpersonal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of an additional 3 to 12 months of employment related to career-enhancing activities. 

The option for career-enhancing work may be offered to a candidate who has clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department deems it necessary. This will be clarified with the candidate during and after any interview. 

If you cannot document skills in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish at level A2 upon employment, NTNU offers the opportunity to take Norwegian courses corresponding to at least 15 credits. NTNU will facilitate this. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Electric Power Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant explains personal motivation, briefly summarizes scientific work, and describes how their background is a good fit (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages, including references). This proposal shall neither be deemed final nor binding for the project.
  • CV.
  • If you have testimonials of work experience, submit them.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not yet completed your Master's thesis, you must provide confirmation of your estimated submission date for the Master's thesis, or confirmation that your Master's thesis has been submitted.
    • Applicants from universities outside Norway are asked to provide a diploma supplement or similar document that details the study program and grading system. 
  • A copy of the Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you are encouraged to include a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be provided before assuming the position. 
  • If you have publications or other relevant research work, submit them.
  • You are encouraged to include documentation of English language proficiency if you are not a native speaker of English. 
  • Name and contact information of three referees.


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

jobs.title: Drive the Technology Behind Our Digital Growth
jobs.description:
Are you a senior developer who enjoys balancing hands-on development with technical leadership? Do you thrive in environments where technology has a direct impact on customer experience, business growth and digital innovation?

 

NutraQ is an international, technology-driven company operating across 15 European markets and the US. As our business continues to grow, we are strengthening our eCommerce team and establishing a new key role: Tech Lead eCommerce.

 

This is a unique opportunity to take technical and professional lead within the eCommerce team and shape the development of our platforms. You will play a central role in shaping our technical direction, guiding a distributed development team and ensuring our ecosystem continues to support growth, scalability and great customer experiences.

 

Alongside Head of eCommerce and UX, you will drive the development and continuous improvement of our platform, translating business needs into robust technical solutions that drive conversion and customer satisfaction.

You will report to the Head of eCommerce and be part of a professional and experienced tech-team of developers and UX designers. Together with the team you will be a key contributor to NutraQ's continued investment in technology and digital development.

 

What you will be responsible for

  • Ensure high-quality delivery by coaching and supporting in-house tech team and external developers, promoting knowledge sharing and building strong technical capabilities across the team.
  • Provide technical guidance on architecture, technology choices and implementation.
  • Actively contribute to hands-on development, including coding and implementation, while promoting coding standards, technical best practices and high-quality solutions.
  • Drive engineering efficiency and team output by integrating modern AI tools, automated processes, and optimized workflows into daily practices.
  • Drive improvements across our web ecosystem, including CMS, performance, integrations, customer journeys and functionality.

What you bring

We believe the right candidate combines strong technical capabilities with a pragmatic mindset and the ability to create direction and engagement among developers.

 

You likely bring:

  • Strong experience in web development, ideally within D2C e-commerce or subscription-based businesses.
  • Strong full-stack skills across modern frontend frameworks, backend systems, APIs and CMS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technology used for modern web applications. We use React, Next and .NET as of now.
  • Experience across the full development lifecycle, from architecture and technical direction to implementation and optimisation
  • Experience mentoring, coaching or technically guiding developers.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms and modern web technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; Scandinavian languages are a plus.
  • Exceptional drive and proactive approach.
  • Curiosity and a strong interest in keeping up with technological developments.

Why join NutraQ?

At NutraQ, technology is a critical driver of business success. As Tech Lead eCommerce, you will have the opportunity to influence both technology and business outcomes in a highly visible role.

 

We offer:

  • A newly established key position with significant influence on technical direction and future platform development.
  • The opportunity to combine technical lead with hands-on development.
  • Being part of a highly experienced and stable international development environment.
  • A dynamic and entrepreneurial culture with short decision-making paths and high trust.
  • The opportunity to work with modern technology, eCommerce and AI in an international company with ambitious growth plans.
  • Competitive employee benefits.
  • Modern offices at Skøyen in Oslo.
  • A unique and strong culture where our people focus on having fun, collaboration and development.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please contact Christina Waale Salomaa (+47 909 769 86 / cws@greatpeople.no) or Elisabeth Hagen (+47 924 12 119 / eh@greatpeople.no) for a conversation about this exciting opportunity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NutraQ group is a leading international company within the health and beauty industry, owned by Orkla. We develop, produce and distribute a broad range of products directly to consumers through a digital non-binding subscription business model, with a turnover around 1,4 billion NOK.

jobs.title: Materiaalikoordinaattori
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?

Haemme nyt sisustusmateriaalien materiaalikoordinaattoria liittymään Architectural Accommodation osastolle, joka toimii osana Hotel Design -yksikköä!

Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa.

Hotel Design yksikkömme vastaa laivan kaikkien yleisten tilojen ulkoasusta ja suunnittelusta. Tähän kuuluvat hytit, hyttialueet, julkiset tilat (kuten teatterit, ravintolat ja miehistön julkiset tilat), hotellin palvelutekniset tilat ja arkkitehtoniset ulkoalueet. Yksikön vastuulla on toteuttaa asiakkaamme toimittaman arkkitehtimateriaalin design, sääntöjen, määräysten ja sovitun tason sallimissa puitteissa. Vastaamme myös eri järjestelmien reitityksen, sijainnin ja sijoittelun suunnittelusta sekä rungon suunnitteluun tarvittavien aukkojen koordinoinnista.

Architectural Accommodation osasto vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.

Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Material Coordination tiimimme vastaa matkustajille ja miehistölle näkyvien tilojen perussuunnittelusta ja tiettyjen materiaalien hankinnasta – sinun roolisi osana tiimiäsi on varmistaa, että tehtävään liittyvät hankintakokonaisuudet pysyvät hallinnassa moniprojektiympäristössä. Tiloja ovat esimerkiksi mm. hyttialueitten käytävät, sairaala ja ohjaamo.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Tehtävääsi kuuluu materiaalikoordinaattorille nimetyn kokonaisuuden hallinta. Toimimme moniprojektiympäristössä eli osallistut tehtäväkokonaisuuden vastuullisena samanaikaisesti usean eri laivaprojektin vaiheisiin alusta loppuun. Toteutamme arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut laivanrakennuksen sääntöjen ja määräysten mukaan.

Tehtäväsi on koordinoida telakan rakentamien alueiden sisustusmateriaalien ja kalusteiden hankintoja osana tiimiä. Hankittavia materiaaleja ovat esimerkiksi katto- ja seinämateriaalit, kaiteet, verhot, WC-materiaalit. Valmistelet tekniset määritelmät ja rajaukset hankintoja varten, laadit kyselyaineiston liitteineen ja vastaat tarve- ja toimitusaikatauluista. Hankinnat tapahtuvat yhteistyössä ostajan kanssa.

Tehtävässä olet vastuussa budjetoinnista ja hankintakokonaisuuksiin liittyvien kulujen seurannasta ja hallinnasta. Ennakointi sekä kehitys- ja säästötoimenpiteet kuuluvat vastuullesi.

Tehtävään kuuluu vahva kommunikaatio eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut neuvotteluihin kokonaisuuksien asiantuntijana. Materiaalin ekologisuuden ja soveltuvuuden selvittäminen käyttötarkoitukseen on vastuullasi ja hyväksytät ratkaisut ja toteutuksen tarvittaessa asiakkaallamme sekä tuotannossa.

Materiaaliosaamisen lisäksi tehtävä vaatii ymmärrystä teknisistä vaatimuksista ja ratkaisuista.

Työtehtäväsi ryhmässä muokkautuu ja kehittyy kokemuksesi mukaisesti. Nyt haemme henkilöä kasvamaan vastuulliseen tehtävään.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan, arkkitehtien ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.

Sinulla on kyky toimia hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä, joka taas edellyttää kykyä suunnitella oma ajankäyttö projektien tarpeiden mukaan.

Taitoa ja näkemystä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa, joka on neuvotteluja ja päivittäistä kanssakäymistä telakan projektiosaston, perussuunnittelu- ja sisustusvarustelun osastojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös materiaalitoimittajien kanssa neuvotteluja ja tiedonvaihtoa läpi projektien. Telakan organisaatiossa edustetaan systeemin parasta osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan laivateollisuudessa yleisesti käytettyjen sisustusmateriaalien ja toimittajien tuntemus, kustannustieto sekä laivapuolen sääntöjen ja vaatimusten tuntemus.

Seuraavien ohjelmistojen hallintaa: Excel ja muut Office ohjelmat, SAP, Kronodoc /Wave, AutoCad / jonkin 3D ohjelma

Olet oma-aloitteinen, tartut reippaasti toimeen ja haluat olla mukana luomassa positiivista ja kannustavaa ilmapiiriä. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista ja tehtävään sopiva koulutus. Lisäksi tarvitset hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills

Kunden är aktiv och gillar att gå på bio, teater och åka på utflykter. Du kommer vara kundens förlängda armar och ben, och din närvaro kommer göra en verklig skillnad i hans liv.  Kunden har en egen bil som assistent kör när man ska på aktiviteter så körkort är ett krav för tjänsten.
