o Knowledge of hydraulic circuits, servo valves etc and its applications

o Knowledge of qualification test standards such as DO-160 and MIL-STD-810, ARP1383

o Understand qualification test requirements and create a qualification test plan, test procedures, test reports and analysis & similarity reports.

o Able to understand and interpret test data.

o Identify and evaluate test facilities to meet test requirements and coordinate with the suppliers.

o Assistance in off-site testing including transportation, assembly and commissioning of all necessary support equipment, and performance of function tests during off-site testing.

o Failure reporting of the tests and working with cross functional teams to analyze the failures.

o Actively participate in a team environment to meet project objectives.

o Ensure 5S in the test lab before and after the test activities.

o Strong application of health and safety compliance and risk assessment

Erikoistuminen ja tasokas ammattiosaaminen pitää yrityksen tilauskannan positiivisena seesteisinäkin aikoina ja ympäri vuoden sekä luo kasvupotentiaalia. Etsimmekin nyt telineasentajaa alalla jo vuosikymmeniä toimineen asiakasyrityksemme tehtäviin Tampereen talousalueelle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työt koostuvat rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat Tampereella sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista. Tekijän asuinpaikasta riippuen useimpiin työkohteisiin pääsee joustavasti myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen ja sopimuksen mukaisesti.

Arvostamme hakijassa luonnollisesti kokemusta vastaavista asennustöistä, sillä telineiden ja konsoleiden asennus lujasti ja turvallisesti on ensisijaisen tärkeätä. Otamme haussa huomioon myös alaa kokemattomat tehtävään soveltuvat hakijat. Työssä menestymiseen siivittää halu sekä kyky aktiiviseen ja fyysiseen tekemiseen sekä vastuullinen työote. Oleellista on säilyttää toimintakyky korkeammallakin työskennellessä. Tehtävään annetaan asianmukainen perehdytys ja kollegoiden tuki sekä työhön kuuluvat varusteet.

Tehtävässä voidaan aloittaa pikaisestikin sopivan henkilön löydyttyä kauttamme määräaikaisella vuokratyösuhteella, jonka päätteeksi tekijän on tarkoitus jatkaa vakituisessa työsuhteessa asiakasyrityksessämme pitkäaikaisesti.

Tässä on toimeliaalle tekijälle hyvä työ hyvin hoidetussa ja työntekijöistään välittävässä yrityksessä. Tarjoamme työvaatetuksen, perustasoa kattavammat työterveyspalvelut sekä Clickin oman yhteyshenkilön vahvan tuen.

jobs.title: Byggdrifter
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å ta vare på byggene som betyr mest for innbyggerne i Stavanger?

Som byggdrifter i Stavanger kommune får du en variert arbeidshverdag med ansvar for alt fra historiske bygg i Gamle Stavanger til moderne tekniske anlegg i skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, kulturbygg og administrasjonsbygg.

Hos oss får du bruke fagkompetansen din, løse praktiske og tekniske utfordringer og ta ansvar for at byggene fungerer slik de skal. Du får stor grad av selvstendighet i arbeidshverdagen, samtidig som du blir en del av et stort fagmiljø med kollegaer innen flere tekniske fag.
Stavanger kommune har en av regionens største og mest varierte eiendomsporteføljer. Seksjon Byggdrift har ansvar for drift og oppfølging av over 650 kommunale bygg og rundt 3 000 boliger.

Vi søker nå fire byggdriftere i 100 % faste stillinger til ulike deler av kommunens bygningsportefølje.


Én av stillingene vil ha Rennesøy og Finnøy som sitt primære arbeidsområde. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom du er spesielt interessert i denne stillingen.
Blant byggene vi ønsker å styrke oppfølgingen av er Sølvberget bibliotek og kulturhus. Vi er derfor også interessert i kandidater som motiveres av å jobbe med et stort og publikumsintensivt bygg med varierte tekniske og driftsmessige behov. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden dersom arbeid knyttet til Sølvberget er av særlig interesse.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Drift og oppfølging av kommunale bygg og boliger
  • Oppfølging og kontroll av tekniske anlegg
  • Utførelse av planlagte drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver
  • Internkontroll og oppfølging av lovpålagte oppgaver
  • Registrering, dokumentasjon og rapportering i digitale FDV-systemer
  • Behandling og oppfølging av innmeldte avvik
  • Samarbeid med brukere, leverandører og kollegaer
  • Bidra til systematisk, bærekraftig og forebyggende byggdrift
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev som byggdrifter er ønsket kompetanse og vil bli vektlagt
  • Har du et annet relevant teknisk fagbrev, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg. Erfaring fra byggdrift, tekniske anlegg og systematisk oppfølging av bygg vil bli særlig vektlagt
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig
  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Er serviceinnstilt og trives med kontakt med brukerne av byggene våre
  • Jobber strukturert og er opptatt av kvalitet
  • Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å utvikle deg faglig
  • Ser verdien av god og forebyggende byggdrift
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • En variert arbeidshverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar i egen arbeidshverdag
  • Arbeid med alt fra historiske bygg til moderne tekniske anlegg
  • Et av regionens største fagmiljøer innen byggdrift og teknisk eiendomsforvaltning
  • Et arbeidsmiljø hvor vi deler kunnskap, hjelper hverandre og gjør hverandre gode
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling innen byggdrifterfaget og moderne byggdrift
  • Mulighet til å være med og utvikle hvordan Stavanger kommune drifter byggene sine
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk
  • Ansettelser foretas fortløpende

Lønn

  • Byggdriftere med fagbrev i byggdrifterfaget lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 584 400–600 800 (751700 – Fagarbeider)
  • Søkere med andre relevante fagbrev lønnes for tiden innenfor lønnsspennet kr 550 000–572 800 (751700 – Fagarbeider)

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 
Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:
Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Vedlegg:
Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

jobs.description:
SALES AGENT – MÁLAGA 🇪🇸

För dig som vill arbeta med försäljning på en hög nivå. 📈

Vi söker nu drivna och ambitiösa Sales Agents till vårt växande team i Málaga.

Du kommer att arbeta med försäljning av finansiella tjänster inom investeringsområdet, där du ansvarar för hela säljprocessen – från den första kontakten med kunden till uppföljning, presentation och avslutad affär. 🤝

Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med höga ambitioner, tydliga mål och en prestationsorienterad arbetsmiljö. 🎯

💼 ROLLEN

Du kommer dagligen att arbeta med både nya och befintliga kunder.

Ditt ansvar är att skapa kontakt, bygga förtroende, förstå kundens behov och på ett professionellt sätt presentera företagets tjänster.

Du driver därefter processen framåt genom uppföljning, hantering av invändningar och kontinuerlig dialog med kunden – hela vägen till avslut. 📞

Du får alltså inte bara ansvara för en del av försäljningen.

Du äger affären från början till slut.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    📞 Kontakta nya och befintliga kunder
    💬 Genomföra professionella säljsamtal
    🔎 Identifiera kundens behov och förutsättningar
    📊 Presentera företagets tjänster och erbjudande
    🧠 Hantera invändningar och driva dialogen framåt
    🔄 Arbeta strukturerat med uppföljningar
    🤝 Ansvara för hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut
    🎯 Arbeta mot individuella och gemensamma försäljningsmål
    🚀 Kontinuerligt utveckla din försäljning tillsammans med teamet

🔥 VEM VI SÖKER

Vi söker inte nödvändigtvis personen med längst erfarenhet.

Vi söker personen med rätt driv.

Du är ambitiös, social och tävlingsinriktad. Du tycker om att mäta dina resultat, du tar feedback på allvar och du vill hela tiden bli bättre på det du gör.

Tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning är meriterande, men inget krav.

Vi har en strukturerad utbildning på plats och ger dig de kunskaper och verktyg som krävs för att komma in i rollen. 🎓

Det vi förväntar oss tillbaka är att du kommer in med energi, disciplin och viljan att prestera.

Du behöver kunna hantera att höra nej.

Du behöver kunna ta ansvar när resultaten inte är där.

Och framför allt behöver du vilja bli bättre.

Varje dag. 📈

💰 VILLKOR & ERSÄTTNING

Vi erbjuder en stabil grundlön som ger dig tryggheten i vardagen, kombinerat med en provisionsmodell utan tak.

Det finns alltså ingen övre gräns för hur mycket du kan tjäna.

Din ersättning påverkas av din prestation – och möjligheten att öka din inkomst följer med din utveckling som säljare. 💸

Arbetstider

Måndag–torsdag: 09:45–19:00

Fredag: 08:45–16:00

Du arbetar enligt svensk kalender, vilket innebär att svenska helgdagar och röda dagar gäller även om du arbetar från Málaga.

Det innebär bland annat att du är ledig på svenska högtidsdagar som midsommar, jul och andra svenska helgdagar. 🇸🇪

🏆 EN MILJÖ FÖR PRESTATION

Vi bygger en organisation där det ska vara tydligt vad som krävs för att lyckas.

Målen är höga. Tempot är högt. Konkurrensen är en del av vardagen.

Samtidigt arbetar vi aktivt med coaching, utveckling och teamkänsla. 🤝

Vi tror på att skapa en miljö där ambitiösa människor kan växa – både professionellt och personligen.

För rätt person finns det dessutom möjlighet att växa vidare inom organisationen i takt med att du utvecklas och visar vad du går för.

Här ska du kunna se skillnaden mellan att bara gå till jobbet – och att faktiskt bygga en karriär. 🚀

🌴 VARFÖR MÁLAGA?

Du får möjligheten att bygga din karriär inom försäljning samtidigt som du bor och arbetar i Málaga.

Ett internationellt arbetsliv, ett ambitiöst team och en stad där arbetsdagarna kombineras med ett liv utanför kontoret. ☀️

Det är en miljö som passar människor som vill framåt.

⚡ DET HÄR ÄR FÖR DIG SOM…

…inte vill stå och stampa på samma plats om ett år som du gör idag.

Du kanske redan arbetar med försäljning och vill ta nästa steg.

Eller så kanske du är helt ny inom branschen men vet att du har det som krävs för att bli riktigt bra.

Oavsett vilket är vi mer intresserade av din potential än din titel på CV:t.

Om du är beredd att lägga ner arbetet, ta coachningen och ständigt höja din egen nivå, finns här en möjlighet att bygga något långsiktigt.

Så om du känner att det här är miljön du vill utvecklas i – då vill vi höra från dig.

Skicka in din ansökan och låt oss ta det därifrån. 🔥

jobs.title: Sc. Officer Ecotoxicologist, Sc. Officer Toxicologist
jobs.description:
1\. The job

We are looking for Scientific Officers for two profiles in the fields of environmental sciences and human health toxicology. Scientific Officers may also work on the implementation of the new tasks recently taken over by ECHA, such as the Drinking Water Directives (DWD) and Batteries Regulation.

2\. Key responsibilities

**Work profile 1: Ecotoxicologist**

Evaluating registration dossiers (e.g., experimental studies and adaptations) against the information requirements in the REACH Regulation, examining testing proposals, preparing draft decisions, and responding to comments received on draft decisions;

Application and evaluation of methodologies alternative to animal testing, such as read-across, QSAR and grouping in regulatory risk assessment;

Assessing and providing expert opinions on ecotoxicology and environmental fate, the relevance and reliability of experimental studies, assessing and evaluating relevance and conclusions made in the environmental effect, exposure and PBT/PMT assessment and risk characterization of substances;

Assessing the environmental hazard profile of chemical substances in relation to classification and labelling obligations (in particular PBT/v P v B, PMT/v P v M, and environmental endocrine disruptors criteria);

Preparing and/or supporting the development of the Agency's decisions and opinions;

Preparing, managing, and follow-up of the meetings of ECHAs Committees, relevant working groups, and expert groups, including support to their Chairs, rapporteurs, and dossier submitters;

Assessing reports prepared by the Member States competent authorities responsible for CLP and BPR;

Working on the implementation of ECHAs tasks.

**Work profile 2: Toxicologist**

Evaluating registration dossiers (i.e., experimental studies and adaptations) against the information requirements in the REACH Regulation, examining testing proposals, preparing the corresponding draft decisions, and responding to comments received on draft decisions;

Application of methodologies alternative to animal testing, such as read-across, QSAR and grouping for the purpose of regulatory risk assessment;

Assessing and providing expert opinions on toxicology, the relevance and reliability of experimental studies, assessing and evaluating relevance and conclusions made in the toxicological effect, exposure and risk characterization;

Assessing the toxicological hazard profile of chemical substances in relation to classification and labelling obligations (in particular carcinogenic, reprotoxic, mutagenic, and endocrine disruptors criteria);

Preparing and/or supporting the development of the Agency's decisions and opinions;

Preparing, managing, and follow-up of the meetings of ECHAs Committees, relevant working groups, and expert groups, including support to their Chairs, rapporteurs, and dossier submitters;

Assessing reports prepared by the Member States competent authorities responsible for CLP and BPR.

Working on the implementation of ECHAs tasks.

3\. Minimum qualifications

Successful completion of a full course of university studies attested by a degree, where the normal duration of university education is three (3) years or more.

4\. Professional experience

There is no minimum professional experience requirement to be eligible for this profile.

5\. Selection criteria

If you meet the eligibility criteria, you will be assessed on the basis of the following selection criteria:

- **Your academic and professional qualifications** and their relevance to the main areas of work listed in section 3;


Preference will be given to qualifications obtained in or covering the following fields:

**For work profile 1:**

Your university degree must be in environmental sciences, biology, chemistry or another closely related natural science discipline.

Preference will be given to qualifications obtained in or covering the following fields:

o Ecotoxicology;

o Environmental fate;

o Environmental endocrine disruptors;

o Environmental risk assessment of chemical substances (e.g. industrial chemicals, pesticides, biocides).

**For work profile 2:**

Your university degree must be in toxicological sciences.

Preference will be given to qualifications obtained in or covering the following fields:

o Toxicology;

o Pharmacology;

o Biomedical sciences, covering human health risk assessment of chemical substances (e.g. industrial chemicals, pesticides, biocides).

- **Your professional experience (for both profiles)**: Preference will be given to candidates having experience in functions similar to those outlined in section 2. The Selection Committee will assess the range of fields covered, the type, and level of work done and its relevance to the areas of work listed in section 2.


The following will be considered as **assets for work profile 1, Scientific Officer – Ecotoxicologist:**

· Practical experience in conducting or interpreting experimental studies or data generated by New Approach Methodologies (NAM) for hazard or risk assessment;

· Scientific publications as the corresponding author in a relevant field, or experience with preparing regulatory dossiers or guidance material (e.g. REACH, CLP, BPR, POP);

· Documented experience in data curation and statistical analysis (demonstrated through scientific publications, regulatory assessments, technical reports or equivalent outputs);

· Work experience gained in a similar multicultural environment. Preference will be given to work experience abroad.

The following will be considered as **assets for work profile 2, Scientific Officer – Toxicologist**:

· Practical experience in conducting or interpreting experimental studies or data generated by New Approach Methodologies (NAM) for hazard or risk assessment;

· Scientific publications as the corresponding author in a relevant field, or experience with preparing regulatory dossiers or guidance material (e.g. REACH, CLP, BPR, POP);

· Documented experience in data curation and statistical analysis (demonstrated through scientific publications, regulatory assessments, technical reports or equivalent outputs);

· Work experience gained in a similar multicultural environment. Preference will be given to work experience abroad.

jobs.title: POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER in Quantum Computing Middleware and Applications
jobs.description:
The University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en), founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research.The Department of Computer Scienceis a leading unit in Finland in its area and responsible for the teaching and research in computer science at the University of Helsinki.
The Department of Computer Sciences invites applications for a POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER in Quantum Computing Middleware and Applications.
The quantum software group at the University of Helsinki consists of close to ten researchers looking at quantum computing from the computer science perspective with an empirical research methodology. The position is fixed-term for 2 years with a possible extension of 2,5 years.

Position description
The work is part of a new UnloQ project, which aims to bridge the gap between early-stage quantum technology and industrial use. This requires cooperation of all layers in the quantum stack. We are particularly interested in a mix of three aspects: circuit optimization, evolving error correction techniques, and applications. We use locally hosted quantum computers based on superconducting technology in our experiments as well as the resources of our national supercomputing center.
The work involves developing ideas and techniques, implementing experiments in code and running them on 50 (and upcoming 300) qubit quantum computers, analyzing the results and documenting them in scientific papers. Collaboration with other team members and supervision of MSc and PhD students are part of the work. The position has a trial period of 6 months.

Requirements
The ideal candidate has a PhD in quantum computing or in computer science with a quantum perspective. Skills to implement quantum programs in QisKit, Qrisp, or other major quantum programming environments are essential. Teamworking and communication skills are important as our project involves working together with our industry partners. Creativity and agility are important in this fast-moving area. Good written and oral communication skills in English will be needed.

Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (requirement level 5). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 4000-4400 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.

How to apply
Applications should include:
* a CV with a list of publications,
* a brief description of your research interests (1 page) with clear indication on the motivation to apply for this position,
* a copy of a PhD degree certificate.

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is 21.10. Interviews will commence right away, already during the application period. The ideal start date is as soon as possible, at the latest January 1st 2027.
Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
External applicants, please submit your application via the Apply Now button.
Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Professor Jukka K. Nurminen (jukka.k.nurminen@helsinki.fi).
Here you can find further information about the research group https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/empirical-software-engineering/quantumhel.

jobs.title: Fagansvarlig LCC og bærekraft
jobs.description:
fStavanger kommune eier og forvalter distriktets største og mest varierte eiendomsportefølje. Denne omfatter blant annet skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, idrettsbygg, kulturbygg, administrasjonsbygg og verneverdige bygninger i Gamle Stavanger. Hver dag brukes disse byggene av tusenvis av innbyggere og ansatte, og gode beslutninger om materialvalg, klima og ressursbruk er en viktig forutsetning for trygg og velfungerende drift.

Vi søker nå en fagansvarlig LCC og bærekraft som vil være med på å videreutvikle hvordan kommunen arbeider med livssykluskostnader, livssyklusanalyser og bærekraftige løsninger. Du får en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å sikre bærekraftige og kunnskapsbaserte beslutninger i både eksisterende bygg og nye byggeprosjekter. Rollen kombinerer strategisk fagutvikling, analysearbeid, rådgivning og praktisk oppfølging av problemstillinger knyttet til økonomi, klima og miljø i en av regionens mest spennende eiendomsporteføljer.

Stillingen er plassert i Byggteknisk fagenhet i seksjon Formålsbygg, Stavanger Eiendom. Seksjonen har det overordnede ansvaret for forvaltning, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling av kommunens formålsbygg.

Byggteknisk fagenhet består av erfarne fagansvarlige og rådgivere innen bygg, brann, VVS, elektro, automasjon, byggsikkerhet og renhold. Sammen utvikler vi kommunens faglige standarder, gir teknisk rådgivning og bidrar til gode løsninger innen forvaltning, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling av byggene våre. Fagenheten har også en sentral rolle i utforming av tekniske krav, prosjekteringsanvisninger, rammeavtaler og strategiske utviklingsprosjekter. Stillingen inngår i et tett samarbeid med øvrige fagansvarlige i Byggteknisk fagenhet. Særlig samarbeidet med fagansvarlig bygningsteknikk vil være viktig for å sikre at kommunen utvikler bygg som både er teknisk robuste, bærekraftige og kostnadseffektive gjennom hele levetiden.

Som fagansvarlig LCC og bærekraft får du det overordnede fagansvaret for kommunens arbeid med livssykluskostnader, livssyklusanalyser og bærekraftsvurderinger knyttet til bygg. Du skal ikke bare gi råd, men aktivt bidra til at kommunen utvikler og styrker sitt arbeid med bærekraftige investeringer gjennom standardisering, analyse, kompetanseutvikling og metodisk utviklingsarbeid.

Du vil være kommunens fagressurs og rådgiver innen livssykluskostnader, klimavurderinger og materialstrategi, og skal være en pådriver for kontinuerlig forbedring av metoder, arbeidsprosesser og beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen innebærer ansvar for å identifisere risiko og forbedringsområder, sette retning for fagområdet og sikre at vurderinger knyttet til livssykluskostnader, klima, miljø og bærekraft ivaretas gjennom hele byggenes livsløp, fra tidligfase og prosjektering til drift, vedlikehold og utvikling. Stillingen krever evne til å arbeide strategisk og langsiktig, samtidig som du bidrar med konkrete vurderinger og beslutningsgrunnlag i hverdagen. Du vil ha en sentral rolle i samspillet mellom eiendomsforvaltning, drift, prosjektorganisasjon og eksterne samarbeidspartnere


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som fagansvarlig LCC og bærekraft vil du være kommunens fremste fagressurs innen livssykluskostnader, livssyklusanalyser og bærekraftige materialvalg. Du får en sentral rolle i utviklingen av metoder, standarder og beslutningsgrunnlag som bidrar til bærekraftige og kostnadseffektive investeringer.

  • ha fagansvar for og videreutvikle kommunens arbeid med LCC, LCA og bærekraftsvurderinger
  • være kommunens fagressurs og rådgiver innen livssykluskostnader, klimavurderinger og materialstrategi
  • utvikle metoder, standarder og arbeidsprosesser som bidrar til bedre beslutningsgrunnlag for investeringer, vedlikehold og materialvalg
  • etablere og videreutvikle krav til LCC, LCA, EPD og klimagassvurderinger i kommunens prosjekter
  • følge utviklingen innen bærekraft, regelverk, standarder og analyseverktøy og omsette ny kunnskap til kommunale krav og rutiner
  • representere Stavanger kommune i relevante faglige nettverk og samarbeidsfora
  • bidra til utvikling av kommunens prosjekteringsanvisninger, kravspesifikasjoner og standarder innen bærekraft og livssyklusanalyse
  • bistå prosjektorganisasjonen med analyser og vurderinger i tidligfase og prosjektering
  • utarbeide beslutningsgrunnlag, rapporter og faglige anbefalinger knyttet til investeringer og materialvalg
  • bidra til utvikling av kommunens arbeid med sirkulærøkonomi, ombruk og ressursoptimalisering
  • gi faglig støtte og opplæring til prosjektledere, rådgivere og forvaltere innen fagområdet
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen bygg, ingeniørfag, bærekraft, miljø, energi eller tilsvarende fagområde
  • Erfaring med LCC- og LCA-metodikk innen bygg-, eiendoms- eller anleggssektoren
  • God kunnskap om klimaregnskap, EPD-er og miljøvurdering av materialer
  • God kunnskap om relevante standarder, forskrifter og veiledninger innen fagområdet
  • Erfaring med analysearbeid og beslutningsstøtte knyttet til investeringsprosjekter
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • Det er en fordel dersom du har:
    -erfaring med One Click LCA, Simapro eller tilsvarende analyseverktøy
    -erfaring med BREEAM-NOR
    -erfaring med klimagassregnskap for bygg
    -erfaring med utvikling og bruk av PCR-er og EPD-dokumentasjon
    -kjennskap til FutureBuilt, taksonomi eller andre bærekraftsrammeverk
    -erfaring med offentlige anskaffelser
    -erfaring med utarbeidelse av kravspesifikasjoner og funksjonsbeskrivelser
    -kjennskap til tekniske forskrifter, NS-standarder og Byggforskserien
    -erfaring fra byggeprosjekter eller eiendomsforvaltning

Arbeidsspråket i Stavanger kommune er norsk. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språkferdigheter tilsvarende B2. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du bygger gode relasjoner, skaper tillit og samarbeider godt med kolleger, samarbeidspartnere og brukere
  • Du kommuniserer tydelig, samarbeider godt på tvers av fagområder og håndterer krevende problemstillinger på en konstruktiv måte
  • Du er faglig nysgjerrig, deler kunnskap og bidrar aktivt til utvikling og forbedring
  • Du arbeider strukturert og selvstendig, og har gode evner til planlegging, prioritering og oppfølging.
  • Du har et helhetlig perspektiv og evner å balansere faglige hensyn opp mot drift, økonomi og langsiktige mål
  • Du har høy etisk bevissthet og opptrer profesjonelt i alle sammenhenger.
  • Du arbeider strukturert og har gode evner til planlegging, prioritering og oppfølging
Vi tilbyr
  • En sentral fagrolle med stor påvirkningskraft på kommunens arbeid med bærekraftige, kostnadseffektive og fremtidsrettede bygg
  • Et sterkt tverrfaglig fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og gode muligheter for faglig sparring og samarbeid.
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og mulighet til å påvirke faglige beslutninger og prioriteringer.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling, kompetanseheving og deltakelse i relevante fagnettverk.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og mulighet for en god balanse mellom arbeid og fritid.
  • Lønn etter avtale ut fra kvalifikasjoner og erfaring, stillingskode 808400 Ingeniør.

ArbeidsstedVeritasveien 25
4007 Stavanger

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 
Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:
Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Vedlegg:
Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

jobs.title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
jobs.description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English

jobs.title: Vedligeholdelsestekniker til Aarhus Havn
jobs.description:
Er du en dygtig maskinarbejder, smed eller mekaniker, der elsker fejlfinding og mekanisk vedligehold? Randstad søger for Aarhus Havn en alsidig kollega til en af byens mest centrale og spændende arbejdspladser.

Vi leder efter dig, der har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og trives med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt – fra præcis mekanik på værkstedet til vedligehold af maskiner i højden. Her bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med en stolt kultur og prioriterer det sociale fællesskab højt.

Om jobbet

Som vores nye vedligeholdelsestekniker bliver du en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer, at alt materiel kører optimalt.
Din primære opgave er løbende drift og vedligehold, så nedbrud på kritisk udstyr undgås.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Vedligehold og fejlfinding på maskiner som kraner, løftegrej, grabber osv.

  • Mekaniske opgaver med drejebænk, fræser, måleteknik og lettere svejsning.

  • Montageopgaver og deltagelse i optimeringsprojekter eller større ombygninger.

  • Håndtering af akutte nedbrud i en omskiftelig hverdag.

Arbejdet kan være fysisk krævende og foregår i alle typer vejr – både på landjorden og i højderne. Det er derfor et krav, at du ikke har højdeskræk.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en profil med et svendebrev inden for metalområdet – f.eks. som maskinarbejder, industritekniker, smed eller entreprenør-/landbrugsmekaniker.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er yderst serviceminded, imødekommende og trives med alsidige opgaver.

  • Trives i et til tider hektisk miljø, hvor prioriteringerne kan skifte hurtigt ved akutte behov.

  • Er en udpræget holdspiller, der har lyst til at indgå i et stærkt kollegialt sammenhold, hvor man også prioriterer sociale sammenkomster og har det godt sammen.

  • Har solid erfaring med vedligehold og fejlfinding på tungt materiel eller produktionsudstyr.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og sætter sikkerheden højest – både for dig selv og andre.

  • Har kørekort B, samt truckcertifikat. Har du kran C, løftegrejsbevis og teleskoplæsser, er det et plus men ikke et krav.

  • Er fortrolig med IT og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Vi tilbyder

En spændende arbejdsplads på Aarhus Havn, hvor to dage sjældent er ens.

  • Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt (kl. 7.00-15.00, fredag til kl. 14.30) med betalt frokostpause.

  • Ingen fast vagt: Der er ingen tvungen vagtordning eller udkald, men du kan blive spurgt om frivilligt overarbejde og tilkald ved kritiske maskinstop.

  • Gode personaleforhold: Kantineordning, sundhedsordning, omsorgsdage, seniordage, aktiv idræts-, kunst- og personaleforening.

  • Parkering: Gratis parkering ved arbejdspladsen.

Ansøgning

Aarhus Havn samarbejder med Randstad i denne rekruttering. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef konsulent v. Randdstad, Stine Høgsted på telefon: 92 92 37 85.

Aarhus Havn ønsker tiltrædelse snarest muligt, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Siivoojia tehdassiivoukseen Nokialle
jobs.description:
Etsimme aurinkoiseen joukkoomme vähintään kuutta huolellista ja luotettavaa

PALVELUVASTAAVAA TEOLLISUUSKOHTEEN SIIVOUSTEHTÄVIIN NOKIALLE

vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita.



Työt alkavat 29.12.2026.

Monipuolinen ja vastuullinen työnkuva

Tehtävässäsi palveluvastaavana huolehdit siisteydestä ja puhtaudesta monipuolisessa teollisuuskohteessa Nokialla. Työpäiväsi ovat vaihtelevia ja pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan työympäristön viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen. Teollisuuden tuotantotiloissa työskenneltäessä on tärkeää ottaa huomioon ympäristön erityispiirteet. Tuotantotiloissa voi olla kuumaa, ja siellä saattaa esiintyä voimakkaita tuoksuja sekä hajuja. Turvallisuus on kohteessa kaiken keskiössä: tuotannon tiloissa on paljon liikennettä, kuten trukkeja ja AGV-vaunuja, joten tarkkaavaisuus ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen on välttämätöntä. Teet työtä itsenäisesti, mutta kuulut isoon tiimiin ja kohtaat päivittäin lukuisia asiakkaan edustajia, joten asiakaspalveluasenne on avainasemassa.

Työtehtäviisi sisältyvät:

- Sosiaali- ja taukotilojen siivous.

- Toimistojen, neuvottelutilojen ja aulojen sekä muiden yleisten tilojen siivous.

- Tuotantotilojen siivous sopimuksen mukaan ja turvallisesti.

- Varmistat osana työyhteisöä, että tilat ovat turvalliset ja esteettömät.

- Vahinkojen ja huoltotarpeiden raportointi ohjeistuksen mukaisesti.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat kello 6–20 välille maanantaista lauantaihin työvuorolistan mukaisesti. Työtunteja kertyy tehtävästä riippuen 15–37,5 tuntia viikossa. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita, joten kerrothan hakulomakkeella kummasta vaihtoehdosta olet kiinnostunut. Koska työajat vaihtelevat aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä, toivomme sinulta joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen sekä valmiutta työskennellä aikaisissa aamuissa ja myöhäisissä illoissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aiempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Kohteessa toimii suuri tiimi ja asiakkaan edustajia, joten sujuva kommunikaatio on tärkeää.

- Joustavuutta työajoissa aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä.

- Täysi-ikäisyyttä.

- Suomen kielen taitoa (taso B1-B2). Turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi sinun tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan suomeksi ja ymmärtämään suomenkieliset työ- ja turvallisuusohjeet täysin.
[Good Proficiency in Finnish (B1-B2 level) is required. Due to safety requirements, you must be able to communicate in Finnish and fully understand work-related and safety instructions provided in Finnish.]

Eduksi katsomme:

- Eritoten kokemus teollisuuden puhtauspalveluiden tuottamisesta katsotaan eduksi.

- Voimassa olevan työturvallisuuskortin.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

- Merkityksellisen työn.

- Mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä esimiehen ja tiimin tuen.

- Laadukkaat ja toimivat työvälineet.

- Koeajan jälkeen lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyden palvelut sekä liikunta- ja hierontaedut käyttöösi.

- SOL Life -ohjelman mukaisen panostuksen työturvallisuuteesi ja hyvinvointiisi.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja edetä urallasi. Tarjoamme koulutuksia ja erilaisia urapolkuja.

Palkka: 13,22 €/h. Palkkaus noudattaa kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta palkkaryhmässä 3.



Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa mahdollisimman pian täyttämällä sähköisen hakemuslomakkeemme huolella ja liittämällä mukaan ansioluettelosi ja/tai hakukirjeesi. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Miia Mustalahti, miia.mustalahti(at)sol.fi. Huomaathan, että otamme hakemukset vastaan ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta.

Me SOLissa käytämme siivoustyön ammattilaisistamme nimitystä palveluvastaava, sillä he ovat vastuussa tuottamastaan palvelusta eli erinomaisesta siivousjäljestä ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä. Jos etsit työtä mukavassa työporukassa ja jossa pääset näkemään kätesi jäljen, hae meille nyt!

Liity osaksi aurinkoista porukkaamme!




Tarjoamme


- Liikunta- ja hierontaetu

- Lakisääteistä laajempi työterveyshuolto

- Työsuhde-edut voimassa koeajan jälkeen.



SOL Palvelut Oy

Meille on tärkeää työssä viihtyminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri – toimintaamme ohjaavat SOL arvot: aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas, arkiluovuus, yrittäjyys, luotettavuus ja iloinen työn tekeminen.
Jos nämä arvot resonoivat kanssasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!
Arvostamiamme ominaisuuksia ovat myös oma-aloitteisuus, vastuullisuus ja täsmällisyys.



SOL on osaava, monipuolinen ja kansainvälisesti toimiva suomalainen palvelualan perheyritys, jonka keskiössä on aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas ja iloinen työn tekeminen.

SOL Palvelut Oy:n palveluihin kuuluu siivous- ja toimitilapalvelut. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme puhtauden ja korkean hygienian ratkaisuja, joilla vaikutamme työympäristöjen viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen.

SOL Palvelut Oy on osa SOL-konsernia, joka työllistää noin 13 000 aurinkoista SOLilaista.



SOL KONSERNI

Iloisiin SOLilaisiin kuuluu [turvallisuusalan, kiinteistönhuollon, talotekniikan, puhtaanapidon ja tekstiilihuollon ammattilaisia](https://www.sol.fi/). Lisäksi tarjoamme [henkilöstövuokrauspalveluja](https://www.sol.fi/palvelut/henkilostopalvelut/) joustavasti eri toimialoille.

Arvostamme osaamista ja ammattitaitoa. Vahva osaaminen taataan räätälöidyillä perehdytyksillä, sisäisillä koulutuksilla sekä oppilaitosyhteistyöllä. Myös eteneminen on mahdollista erilaisten urapolkujen avulla. Työssäsi sinua kannustaa ja tukee oma esihenkilösi sekä koko tiimi.

SOL Life-ohjelman avulla kehitämme työhyvinvointia sekä panostamme työntekijöidemme työturvallisuuteen.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.

[Lue lisää toimintamme vastuullisuudesta ja tarinastamme.](https://www.sol.fi/vastuullisuus/)

[Ohjeet turvalliseen työhön](https://www.esitteemme.fi/SOL/MailView/)
[Guidelines for safe work](https://www.esitteemme.fi/SOL_Kiinteistopalvelut_Oy_ENG/MailView/)

jobs.title: Specialiseret butiksmedarbejder/knivspecialist. Specialist retail assistent - Japanese as working language
jobs.description:
Arbejdssted: København Location: Copenhagen

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 37 timer om ugen. Working hours. Full-time, 37 hours per week.

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Employment: Permanent position.

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Vi tilbyder:

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Løn: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning:

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

Regarding the position:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

The position combines sales and customer service with practical work, involving knife sharpening and maintenance, as well as ongoing communication with our Japanese suppliers and business partners.

A significant part of the postion involves direct communication with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers. Therefore, a high level of Japanese language proficiency is an essential requirement for the position.

Your responsibilities:

Selling and advising customers on Japanese high quality knives and accessories.

Providing customer service andguidance on the selection, use and maintenance of knives.

Knife sharpening, maintenance and hand engraving.

Receiving, checking and handling goods.

Stock and inventory management.

Communication with Japanese suppliers and manufacturers.

Handling product information, orders, specifications and deliveries.

Translating and communicating information between the company and Japanese business partners.

Contributing to the day-to-day operation and presentation of the shop.

We expect you to:

Speak and write Japanese at a high level.

Be able to communicate professionally with Japanese suppliers, both verbally and in writing.

Have an interest in Japanese knives, craftmanship and quality.

Have good customer service and sales skills.

Be detail oriented and quality conscious.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility.

Have an interest in or experience with knife sharpening.

Have a good command of English for communication with colleagues and customers.

Experience in sales, knife sharpening or working with Japaneseknives is an advantage. Experience with hand engraving of knives is also an advantage. Training in the companys products and working methods will be provided as required.

Japanese is an essential working language, as the employee will have regular contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers regarding product information, orders, specifikations, deliveries and other matters related to our Japanese products.

We offer:

A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

Salary: Salary and employment terms according to qualifications and experience.

How to apply: Please send an email with your CV and application to tess@foodgear.dk

Please include information about your experience with Japanese products, knives, sales, customer service as well as your Japanese and English skills.

jobs.title: Waitress
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Digital Twin Modelling and Multi-Timescale Optimization of Electrolysis Systems
jobs.description:
Help to build the digital backbone of tomorrow's Power-to-X plants. This 3-year PhD position offers a unique opportunity to build a research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems. You will drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies, integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand, to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.
  • Publications, if applicable.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?

Further information

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do
  • Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto’s drone and autonomy platform.
  • Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
  • Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
  • Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
  • Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
  • Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
  • Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
  • Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
  • Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
  • Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
  • You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
  • You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
  • Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
  • You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
  • You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
  • You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
  • Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
  • Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
  • Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
  • Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
  • Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
  • Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
  • A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
  • Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
  • Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
  • You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
  • You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
  • You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
  • You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission.We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ambitious ideas into technology that works in the real world.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background, experience and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, computer-vision experience, the systems and products you have worked on, and your approach to solving complex perception problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team.The exercise will be based on a computer-vision problem relevant to the role. We are interested in how you structure the problem, reason about algorithms and architecture, evaluate trade-offs and collaborate with other engineers rather than looking for one specific answer.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have a meaningful opportunity to influence both our technology and how we build it.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have room to challenge approaches, shape technical decisions and take ownership of important parts of our computer-vision stack.Most importantly, your work will move beyond experimentation. You will see the technology integrated, tested and used on real systems in demanding environments.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential.Due to the nature of our work, certain positions may be subject to security-clearance or other eligibility requirements in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Postdoc Position in System Optimization Using Digital Twin for Power-to-X processes
jobs.description:
Take the next step in your research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale system optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems with special focus on the electrical engineering parts. This position offers a unique opportunity to drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies—integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power electronic conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand—to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolyzers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University — research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
This two-year postdoctoral project focuses on the system-level integration and optimization of electrolyzer digital twins within CAPeX — considering how component-level electrolyzer models and digital twins can be incorporated into broader Power-to-X systems involving renewable generation, power conversion, power system integration, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand. In particular, you will:

  • Develop an integrated, system-level digital-twin framework connecting electrolyzer models with relevant Power-to-X components and energy-systema.
  • Develop system-level optimization and energy-management methods for coordinating electrolyzers with renewable generation, power conversion, storage, downstream processes, and hydrogen demand.
  • Apply and evaluate these methods under technical constraints and varying renewable generation, electricity prices, and hydrogen demand, considering system efficiency, flexibility, production, and operating costs.
  • Validate and benchmark the developed framework using project data, high-fidelity simulations including hardware in the loop, and relevant industrial case studies, assessing its robustness and computational performance.
  • Collaborate with researchers and industrial partners, contribute to the coordination and supervision of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies
We expect you to have:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in energy-system modelling, mathematical optimization, control, digital twins, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and numerical modelling skills using Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, hardware in the loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as multi-objective optimization, model predictive control, mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, energy management, or production scheduling.
  • Good knowledge of integrated energy systems; experience with electrolyzers, hydrogen technologies, renewable-energy integration, storage, or Power-to-X systems would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be a specialist in every electrolyzer technology or optimization method. Strong system-level modelling and optimization competence, together with the ability to work across component and system boundaries, is particularly important.

Who we are
The position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following:
